760: Uven kach, atu kol amma, veitpayays malka immehon, veshadar lon lishlam. aval i innun bene mata la atyayn, vechad la akdim leishtae kame malka, leitchazaa beginayyhu deha kullehu atyayn. miyyad kais veragiz malka.

Uf hacha, kevan dechad akdim, veishtechach beve kenishta, ushechinta atya veashkach leh, keden itchashiv keillu kullehu ishtechachu tamman. deha da orich lon tamman. miyad itchabbarat immeh shechinta, veyatve beziuuga chad, veishtemoda bahadeh, veotiv leh bedarga detzaddik. vei chad la akdim vela ishtechach tamman, ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 50:2) maddua bati veen ish. veen asara la ketiv, ella veen ish, leitchabbera bahaday, lemeheve gabbay, kema deat amer ish haelohim lemeheve bedarga detzaddik.

Velo od, ella deishtemoda bahadeh, veshail aloy, i yoma chad la ate, kema (balak 196 amud alef) deokimna, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 50:10) mi vachem yere Adonai shomea bekol avdo. veha ittearna behay dichtiv, elay kore misseir, deha darga batar darga, darga go darga, hahu shomer, kore bechela bechol yoma veyoma, veda ihu shomea bekol avdo, avdo, da metatron. uvegin kach, zakkaa ihu man deakdim leve kenishta, lesalleka behahu darga illaa dekamran.

Kad ate tzafra, vetzibbura ishtechachu beve kenishta, bau leishtakkecha beshirin vetushebchan dedavid. veha okimna, desiddura ihu leitara rechimu leella vetatta, leatkena tikkunin, uleitara chedva. deha begin da levae mitare leitara rechimu vechedva leella, beinnun shirin vetushebchan.

Uman demishtae beve kenishta bemillin dechol, vavy leh, deachaze piruda, vavy let degara mehemnuta. vavy leh delet leh chulaka beelaha deyisrael. deachaze deha let (leh) elaha, vela ishtechach tamman, (velet leh chulakeh beh) vela dachil minneh, veanhig kelana betikkuna (sefer acher batekaypaa) illaa dilella.

Deha beshaata deyisrael mesaddere beve kenishta, siddura deshirin vetushebchan vesiddura ditzlota, keden mitkanneshe telat mashreyayn demalache illae. mashiryayta chada, innun malachin kaddishin (illain) deka meshabbechan lekudesha berich hu bimama, begin deit acharanin deka meshabbechan lekudesha berich hu belelya. veacharanin (sefer acher veillen) innun deka meshabbechan lekudesha berich hu, veamrin shirin vetushebchan bahadayyhu deyisrael bimama.

Mashiryayta tinyayna, innun malachin kaddishin, demishtakkeche bechol kedusha ukedusha deyisrael, mekaddeshe letatta. uveshuletana dilhon, kol innun demitarin bechol innun rekiin, (sefer acher hechalin) behahi tzelota deyisrael (sefer acher dimyushav). mashiryayta telitaa innun (260 amud bet) ulemtan illain. deka mittakkene im matronita, umetakkene lah leaala lah kame malka, veillen innun mashreyayn ilain al kullehu.

(260 Amud bet) vechullehu mittakkene, besiddura deyisrael demitattekne letatta, beinnun shirin vetushebchan, uvehahi tzelota deka metzalu yisrael. kevan deillen telat mashreyayn mizdammenan, keden yisrael patche shirata, vezamre kame marehon. vehahi mashshiryayta chada, di memana leshabbecha lemarehon bimama, izdammenan alayyhu, vezamre immehon kachada, beinnun shevache dedavid malka, veha ukimna mille.

Behahu zimna dimsayyeyme yisrael shevache deinnun tushebchan dedavid, keden tushebachta deshirata deyamma, kema deokimna. vei tema, hay tushebachta amay ihi betikkuna batrayyta batar shevache dedavid, veha tora shebbichtav, akdimat letora shebbeal pe, veakdimat lanneviim, veakdimat lakketuvim, uchema deakdimat, hachi itzterich leakdema. (nusach acher beshirta)

Ella, miggo dekneset yisrael la ittaknat ella mittora shebbichtav, mishshum hachi itzterich lomar lah besheruta detikkunaha, vehay tushebachta mealleya, mikkol shear tushebchan dealma. veihi la ittaknat mikkullehu, kema deittaknat
761: Mittushebachta da. uvegin da, ihi samuch litzlota dimyyushav, kema deokimna.

Bah shaata kad shirata deyamma ittemar, mitattera keneset yisrael behahu kitra, dezammin kudesha berich hu leattera lemalka meshicha, vehahu (8 amud bet) kitra gelifa mechukkaka bishmahan kaddishin, kema deitattar kudesha berich hu hahu yoma deabaru yisrael yat yamma, veatba lechol mashreyayn defaro ufarashohi. begin da, bae bar nash leshavvava reuteh behay shirata. vechol man dezache lah behay alma, (60 amud alef) zache lemecheme lemalka meshicha betikkune hahu kitra, uvachagiru dezayyneh, vezakke leshabbecha hay shirata tamman, veha ukimna mille.

Kevan demate bar nash leyishtabbach natil kudesha berich hu hahu kitra, veshavve leh kameh, ukkeneset yisrael sheriat leittakna lemete kame malka illaa. veitzterich leachlala lah, betlesar mechilan derachame illae, deminnehon itbarchat. veinnun telesar busemin illain, kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 4:14) nerd vecharkom kane vekinnamon vegomer, vehacha innun, shir, ushevacha, hallel, vezimra, oz, umemshala, netzach, gedula, uggevura, tehilla, vetiferet, kedusha. ha teresar. ulevatar lechabbera lah bahadayyhu, velomar umalchut, vahavu telesar. begin deihi mitbarcha minnayyhu.

Veal da itzterich, beshaata deitkelilat benayyhu, leshavvava libba ureuta behay, vela lishtae kelal, dela lifsok benayyhu. vei pasik benayyhu, mittechot gadpe keruveyay nafik chad shalhova, vekare bechela veamar, pelanya di pasik geuta dekudesha berich hu, yishtetze veyitpessak, dela yechome gauta demalka kaddisha, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 26:10) uval yire geut Adonai, begin deillen telesar innun geut Adonai.

Mikkan ulehala el hahodaot kulei, da malka illaa dishlama kolla dileh, begin dechol hane shevachan innun legabbah dekneset yisrael kad mishtabbecha bemashshiryayta diltatta. kema deat amer shir hashshirim asher lishlomo, lemalka dishlama dileh, mittamman ulehala, (Yeshayahu 45:7) yotzer or uvore choshech ose shalom uvore et hakkol. veha ittearna beh, veattearu chavrayyay dehane innun tikkunin dealma illaa. (el adon).
31 Baruch: tikkune dealma tattaa, deinnun 22 atvavn zeirin, begin deit (Bereshit 3 amud bet) atvavn ravrevan, veatvavn zeirin. atvavn zeirin, mealma tattaa. atvavn ravrevan, mehahu alma deate.

Becholla innun ravrevan, innun ravrevan begarmayyhu. kad (lo) atyayn yechidain innun ravrevan (nusach acher dechar venukeba peshitan) dechad lo peshitan yattir, innun atyayn kol at veat birticha dechazze leh, kegon shevacha deshabbat deinnun atvavn deshevach, el adon al kol hammaasim, baruch umevorach befi kol neshama. illen atvavn bachamesh chamesh tevin, deinnun chamshin tarin dealma deate.

Teren atvavn acharanin di besofa: 700. innun beshit shit tevin, deinnun shit sitrin dealma deate, venafke mittamman. kegon: shevach yittenu lo kol tzeva marom. tiferet ugedulla serafim veofannim vechayyot hakkodesh.

Illen teren atvavn, beshit shit teren atvavn kadmae, bechamesh chamesh. kullehu shear atvavn di beemtzaita, kullehu bearba arba, begin deinnun beraza dirticha illaa, deinnun atvavn kadmae veinnun divsofa, innun shelimu dichv atvavn, begin deit behu 22 tevin, lokovel 22 atvavn illain. ishtaaru timnesar atvavn acharanin, deka salkin birtichayyhu learba arba, leshivin uteren tevin, deinnun raza dishma meforash, gelifa kaddisha dev atvavn, dekudesha berich hu mitattar behu. ushema da, ihu meattera likkeneset yisrael, vesalik beraza da, leitattera behu go shelichuta (demareh) dishchinta.
Vesimanicha deillen atvavn, deka mitatteran bishvacha illaa, da kadmae vesofe, desallekin beitterayyhu innun 401 302. alef bechamesh. tav beshit. bet bechamesh. shin beshit. begin kach raza det 302
762: Kelala dechv atvavn, deinnun attara ditlatin uteren shevilin. (sefer acher dishma kaddisha).

Vesiman deinnun atvavn acharanin desallekin birtichayyhu, gar. share begimel, vesiyyem beresh, vechullehu raza dirticha kaddisha. 401 302, raza dishma kaddisha. 203, raza dirticha kaddisha, desalleka lev, veitavid minnayyhu shema kaddisha, leitattera keneset yisrael, miggo reticha illaa. (dichtiv, 0 chishmecha elohim ken tehillatecha)

Uvegin kach hahu shema dev kelila beraza daavahan, yemina usemala veemtzaita. veihi mitattera behu, lemehve shema kaddisha. velav shema illaa, keinnun shemahan illain, dealma illaa, deitachadan leella leella. veaf al gav dehay shema illaa ihu, aval raza dileh, david malka, demitattera baavahan.

Shema demv atvavn raza dileh avahan, deka (Vayikra 79 amud alef, 108, 256 amud bet) mitatteran bealma illaa. vealma illaa bema dilella. (sefer acher vesalleka raza leella leella, ad deitattera bain sof) veal da, salik vela nachit, itattar go machashava illaa. zakkaa chulaka deman deyada leh, veizdehar beh.

Shema dev atvavn, david deka (Bereshit 33 amud bet, 207 amud bet, 234 amud bet, Vayikra 150 amud bet) mitattera baavahan, veraza dileh salik venachit, kegavvna da 300, (300) shema ditlesar mechilin derachame. innun teresar, raza dirticha kaddisha, denafik mechad, desharya alayyhu uvegin kach (salik venachit, vechullehu sallekin venachtin bar hay shemma 46 desalik velo nachit veal da) shema dev salik venachit, salik missitra da, venachit missitra da. shema ditlesar mechilan, salik missitra da, venachit missitra da, vehahu denachit begin leamshacha tivu letatta. veal da, 401 302 203 104 95 86 77 68 59 50 50. atvavn kadmae sallekin bechushebana, veatvavn acharanin nachte bechushebana, begin leamshacha tivu dilella letatta.
Shema demv, ihu mitattera lirticha illaa. shema dev, ihu mitattera lirticha tattaa. zakkaa chulakeh man demishtaddel leminda lemareh, zakkaa ihu bealma den uvealma deate.

Uvegin kach, tushebachta deshabbat deka meshabbecha lemalka dishlama dileh. meshabbach leh bishma dev, 30 tevin, raza dechv atvavn, begin detitatter beh lesalleka leella betushebachta da. veal da, el adon, tushebachta dealma deate ihu, uferichu (sefer acher vaperaykav) dirticha kaddisha illaa, demitattera lesalleka leella, uferichu dichneset yisrael, demitattera lesalleka go reticha illaa.

401 302, Sallekin (261 amud alef) venachtin, kema deittemar. amar leh 42 sallekin vela nachtin, vesimanich, da shabbat bilchodoy. veda shabbat veyom hakkippurim, desalleka raza leella leella, ad demitattera kolla been sof.

El baruch, da siddura deatvavn zeirin, vetikkune keneset yisrael bechol yoma bitzlota. uvegin deinnun atvavn zeirin, let (205 amud bet) revavcha benayyhu, veinnun tikkuni ulematan deatyayn im matronita legabbe malka illaa.

Kedushsha da deka mekaddeshe malache illae, lav ihu beyachid. veha ukimna, kol kedusha deihu belashon hakkodesh, yachid asir leh lememar. targum, leolam beyachid, vela besaggiin, veyachid ihu tikkuna dileh vadday, vela saggiin. vesiman leraza da, shenayim mikra veechad targum. shenayim lishana desaggiin ihu, devadday kedusha delashon hakkodesh asir ihi (129) beyachid. kedushat targum asir ihu besaggiin, ella beyachid leolam. echad targum tanenan, vela teren vela yattir. targum atya lemiuta, vehachi itzterich. lashon hakkodesh atya lirvuyay, vehachi itzterich. demaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. uvetargum moridin velo maalin. echad taninan, vela yattir, vela maalin kelal.
Kedushsha da, kedushata deitkaddeshat shechinta, vechol innun retichin dilah, leittakkena legabbe malka illaa. uvegin deihi kedushat alma tattaa, ihi meyushav vela baamida.
763: Kedusha achara deahadure tzelota, ihi kedushata dealma illaa, uvegin kach ihi baamida, begin leamshacha lah letatta, vechol milloy dealma illaa, ihu baamida vela meyushav.

Uvechol hane kedushete, yisrael mitkaddeshe behu letatta. veal da yisrael mitkaddeshe bikdusha dirticha tattaa meyushav. uvikdushsha dirticha illaa meumad. kedusha achara, ihi (261 amud bet) tosefet kedusha, begine kach ihi batar tzelota. uvegin deihi tosefet kedusha, al kedushan acharanin, ihi levatar tzelota. uvegin dechol chad vechad bae leamshacha aleh mehahu tosefet, ittakkan lechol yachid veyachid kedushat targum.

Vei tema ha it bah kedushat lashon hakkodesh. hahu latztzibbur, leitkaddesha kullehu bichlal, behahu tosefet kedusha. uvegin deyachid let leh reshut, leomrah belashon hakkodesh, uleitkaddesha yechiday, atkinu lah belashon targum, veihu beyachid, leitkaddesha kol chad vechad behahu tosefet, leamshacha aleh kedusha yattir. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, deka mitkaddeshe bekiddushe illae, begin deinnun devekin leella, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kulchem hayyom.

Ketiv (Melachim 2 4:9-10) hinne na yadati ki ish elohim kadosh hu over vegomer, uchetiv naase na aliyyat kir ketanna vegomer, behay kera it lan semach bealma lesiddura ditzlota. hinne na yadati, da ihu reuta deitzterich bar nash leshavvaa begavvih bitzlota. ki ish elohim kadosh hu, da ihu alma illaa, deihu yativ al kurese yekareh, vechol kiddushan nafkin minneh, veihu mekaddesh lechullehu almin. over alenu tamid, mehahu kedusha deihu mekaddesh lechol almin leella, ihu mekaddesh lan behay alma. deha let kedusha leella, ella i it kedushsha letatta, kema deat amer (Vayikra 22:32) venikdashti betoch bene yisrael.

Vehoil vechach hu, naase na aliyyat kir ketanna, da ihu siddura detikkuna (vaychi 228 amud bet) dishchinta, deihi aliyyat kir, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 38:2) vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir. ketanna: begin deihi zeera, kema deat amer (Kohelet 9:14) ir ketanna. venasim lo sham betikkuna da deanan metakkenin, uvesiddura dilan beshirin vetushebachan uvitzlota, (uvetikkuna da) anan metakkenin legabbeh, lenayycha dileh. mitta veshulchan vechisse umenora. arba illen, kullehu bishchinta innun. veihi (kolla) bechol tikkunin illen mittakkenan, legabbe alma illaa besiddura deanan mesadderin.

Besiddura ditzlota dearvit, uvetikkuna dileh, ha mitta. besiddura deinnun karbanin veillavavn, deanan mesadderin betzafra veinnun shirin vetushebchan, ha shulchan. uvehahu siddura ditzlota dimyyushav, uvetikkuna dikriat shema, behahu yichuda deanan metakkenin ha kisse. behahu siddura ditzlota dimumad, uveinnun kedushan, vetosefet kedusha, uvirkan, deanan mesadderin (la) ha menora.

Zakkaa ihu bar nash, deda shavve biruteh, leashlama legabbe mareh bechol yoma, uleatkena hay aliyyat kir ketanna, legabbe mareh behane tikkunin. keden vadday kudesha berich hu yehe ushepizeh bechol yoma. zakkaa ihu behay alma, vezakkaa ihu bealma deate. begin deillen arba, innun tikkune dishchinta, leittakna legabbe balah. bearba tikkunin illen, ittaknat bishfiraha, bechedvavha, bechezvavha, al yede deamma kaddisha bechol yoma.

Mitta ityehivat leh leyaakov leittakkena, veal da yaakov atkin tzelota dearvit. shulchan atkin david malka, beinun shirin vetushebchan deihu atkin, kema deat amer (Tehillim 23:5) taaroch lefanay shulchan neged tzorray. kisse atkin avraham, beitkashsheruta dileh, deavid tivu ushelimu denishmatin lechol bene alma, velet tikkuna dechisse, ella bechesed deavraham, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 16:5) vehuchan bachesed kisse.
764: Atkin yitzchak, deakdish shema dekudesha berich hu leenehon dechol alma, venahir nehiru devutzina illaa behahi kedusha. begine kach, tzerichin amma kaddisha, lomar tadir uleshavvaa reutehon, lesaddera legabbe alma illaa, deihu mareh deveta, ish haelohim, mitta veshulchan vechisse umenora, lemeheve shelimu bechol yoma, ella vetatta.

(Davar acher kan chaser) beshaata deka meyachade yisrael, yichuda deraza dishma yisrael, biruta shelim, keden nafke miggo setimu dealma illaa, chad nehiru, vehahu nehiru batash go butzina dekardinuta, veitpelag le nehorin, veinnun 70 nehorin, be anfin deilana dechayye.

Keden, hahu ilana salik rechin uvusemin, vechol ilani deginta deeden, kullehu sallekin rechin, umeshabbechan lemarehon, deha keden ittakkenat matronita, leaala lachuppa bahade balah, chol innun shayyfin illain, kullehu mitchabberan betiuveta chada, uviruta chada, lemeheve chad bela piruda kelal. ucheden balah ittakkan legabbaha leaala lachuppa beyichuda chad, leityaychada bematronita.

Veal da anan mitteare leh, veamrinan (Devarim 6) shema yisrael, atkin garmach, ha balich yete legabbich betikkunoy, zammin lokovlach. Adonai elohenu Adonai echad, beyichuda chada, biruta chada, belo piruda, dechol innun shayyfin kullehu itavidu chad, veayylin bechad tiuveta.

Kevan deamre yisrael Adonai echad beitaruta deshit sitrin, keden kol innun shit sitrin, itavidu chad vealin bechad tiuveta, veraza da 6 chad peshitu bilchodoy, belo devekuta achara legabbeh, ella ihu bilchodoy pashit mikkolla, veihu chad.

Behahi shaata, matronita mittakkena umitkashsheta, veayylin lah shammashaha bilchishu saggi, legabbe balah, veamre baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed. da ihu bilchishu, dehachi itzterich leaala lah legabbe balah. zakkaa amma deyade da, umesaddere siddura illaa dimhemnuta.
Behahi shaata deitchabberu balah umatronita kachada, keden karoza nafik missitra dedarom, itaru chelin umashreyayn degalle rechimuta legabbe marichon.

Keden ittear chad memana illaa, (127 amud alef) buel shemeh, rav mashreyayn, uvideh arba maftechan, denatil med sitre alma, vechad maftecha itreshim beat 10, umaftecha achara itreshim beat Adonai. vechad maftecha itreshim beat 6. (maftecha achara itreshim bata Adonai) veanach lehu techot ilana dechayye. innun telat maftechan, deitreshimu bitlat atvavn illen, itavidu chad. kevan deitavedu chad, hahu maftecha achara, salik vekaim veitchabbar behahu achara kelala ditlat, vechol innun mashreyayn vechayyaylin ayylin leinun teren maftechan go ginta vechullehu meyachade kegavvna diltatta.

Adonai: da reshimu deat 10, resha illaa devishma kaddisha. elohenu: da ihu raza dirshimu deat Adonai illaa, at tinyayna devishma kaddisha. Adonai: da meshichu deitmeshach letatta, beraza dirshimu deat 6, deinnun teren atvavn itmeshachu lemeheve baatar da, veihu echad. kol hane telata innun chad, beyichuda chad.

Kevan dechol da itavid chad beyichuda chad, veishtear kolla beraza deat 6 shelim, meresha demabbua, umehechala penimaa, veyarit leabba veimma, keden ayylin lematronita bahadeh, deha hasheta ihu shelim bechol tivu illaa, veyachil leatzena lah, ulemehav lah mezona vesippuka kadka yeot. vechol innun shayyfin dileh kullehu chad. keden ayylin lah legabbeh, bilchishu. amay bilchishu. begin dela yitarav zar behahi chedva, kema deat amer (Mishlei 14:10) uvesimchato lo yitarav zar.
Kevan deihu ityachad leella beshit sitrin. uf hachi ihi ityachadat letatta beshit sitrin acharanin. begin lemehve
765: Echad leella, veechad letatta, kema deat amer (Zecharya 14:9) yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad. echad leella beshit sitrin, dichtiv, (Devarim 6:4) shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad. ha shit tevin, lokovel shit sitrin. echad letatta beshit sitrin, (hada hu dichtiv) baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed, ha shit sitrin acharanin beshit tevin. Adonai echad leella, ushemo echad letatta.

Vei tema, ha ketiv echad leella, uletatta la ketiv echad. vaed hu echad, bechillufe atvavn. atvavn didchura la mitchallefe, atvavn denukeba mitchallefe, deha shevacha didchura al nukeba. uvegin dela tishlot ayin hara, anan mechallefe atvavn, dela amrenan echad beitgalyay. uvezimna deate, deyitavar ayin hara mealma, vela tishlot, (bahadah) keden yitkere echad beitgalyay. begin dehashta dehahu sitra achara itdabbak bahadah, lav ihi echad, ella daanan meyachadin lah bilchishu, beraza deatvavn acharanin, veamri vaed.

Aval bezimna deate, deyitperash hahu sitra minah, veyitavar mealma, keden yitkere echad vadday, dela yehe bahadah shuttafu udeviku achara, kema deat amer (Zecharya 14:9) bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad, beitgalya behedya, vela bilchishu, vela beraza.

Veal da, anan meyachadin lah mehahu sitra achara, keman dezammin leachara lemeheve sahid dileh. begin deda ihu sahid dilan, vesitra achara lav ihu sahada legabban. ucheden ihi itperishat mehahu sitra. kevan deatat, anan maalin lah lachuppa legabbe balah, malka illaa, bechol reuta vechavvavna delibba, veal da ihu echad.

Beshaata deihi atat beulemtaha, uvaat leitparsha missitra achara, la atat, ella keman deizdammenat lemechome bikara demalka vela yattir, vehachi machrize deyizdammenun lemechome bikara demalka. kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 3:11) tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo, puku lemechome bikara demalka, keden sitra achara la nicha leh lemecheme, veitperash minah. kevan deatat. kol innun shammashaha, ayylin lah lachuppa bahade malka illaa, bilchishu beraza. deilmale lav hachi, la yitperash minah hahu sitra achara veyitarev chedvavta. aval bezimna deate, deyitperash minah hahi sitra achara, keden bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad.

Kevan dealat lachuppa, veihi bahade malka. illaa, keden anan mitare chedva dimina usemala, kema deat amer (Devarim 6:Adonai) veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechol levavcha vegomer. vehaya im shamoa vegomer. bela dechilu kelal, deha sitra achara la yitkarav tamman, velet leh reshu.

Kalla, kol zimna devaan leaala lah legabbe malka, lechedva deshimmusha, itzterich bilchishu beraza, begin dela yishtechach beragle (bar nash degalle) tzaadaha, remez desitra bisha, vela yitdavak bahadah, vela yishtekchun bevane, remez pisul kelal.

Vehachi amar yaakov livnoy, shemma chas veshalom era pisul (bazeraaay) bearsi, keden innun amru, kema delet belibbach ella echad, kach vechulei let lan deviku besitra achara kelal, deha perisha hava mearsach, vaanan beyichuda legabbe malka illaa, velet lan deviku kelal besitra achara, deha bifrishu missitra achara (nusach acher havenan biru) hava reuta umachashavta dilan.

Kevan deyada desitra achara la itdabbak tamman kelal keden alat itteta, legabbe balah bilchishu, beraza deyichuda deshit sitrin. patach veamar, baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed deha ihi beraza deechad, beulemtaha, bela irbuva kelal vela shuttafu desitra achara.

Veta chazi, behahi shaata, yaakov uvenoy havo bediyyukena illaa letatta bahade shechinta. yaakov hava beraza deshit sitrin dealma illaa, beraza chad. benoy havo bediyyukena deshit sitrin dealma tattaa. veihu baa legallaa lon hahu ketz, kema deokimna, deit ketz veit ketz, it (121 amud alef) ketz hayyamin, veit ketz hayyamim. ketz hayyamin: da malchut kaddisha raza dimhemnuta raza demalchu dishmayya. ketz
766: Hayyamim: da raza demalchu chayyayva raza desitra achara deikre ketz kol basar. veha ukimna.

Kevan dechama deistallakat shechinta minneh vechulei. innun amru kemma delet belibbach ella echad, deant beraza dealma illaa, veihu echad. uf anan, deanan beraza dealma tattaa, ihu echad. veal da adkeru tere levavot, raza dealma illaa, deihu libba deyaakov, veraza dealma tattaa, deihu libba divnoy, keden ail lah bilchishu.

Vechma deinnun ityaychadu raza dealma illaa beechad, veraza dealma tattaa beechad. uf hachi anan tzerichin leyachada alma illaa beechad, uleyachada alma tattaa beraza deechad. da beshit sitrin, veda beshit sitrin. uvegin kach, shit tevin hacha, beraza deshit sitrin. veshit tevin hacha, beraza deshit sitrin, (Zecharya 14) Adonai echad ushemo echad. zakkaa adveh vechulakeh man deyishve reuteh lehay, bealma den, uvealma deate.
Rav hamenuna sava amar hachi, da itaruta deyichuda shappir ihu, deraza divrira demilta ha okimna. umillin illen zeminin leitatteda kame attik yomin, belo kissufa kelal.

Raya mehemna pikkuda lilmod tora bechol yoma, deihi raza dimhemnuta illaa, leminda archeh dekudesha berich hu. dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta, zache behay alma, vezache bealma deate, veishteziv mikkol kitrugin bishin. vegin deorayyta raza dimhemnuta ihi, deman deitassak bah, itassak bimhemanuta illaa, kudesha berich hu ashre shechinteh begavvih dela tade minneh.

Man deyada milla deorayyta, itzterich lemirdaf avatreh, uleolfa hay milla minneh, lekayyeyma raza dichtiv, meet kol ish asher yiddevennu libbo tikchu et terumati. orayyta ilana dechayye ihu, lemehav chayyin lecholla. man deittakkaf beorayyta, ittakkaf beilana dechayye, kema deat amer (Mishlei 3:18) etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah.

Vechamma razin illain okimna beman deishtaddal beorayyta, dezakke leitkashshera beorayyta dilella. behay alma la shachich, vela shachich bealma deate, vaafillu bekivra shifvavteh merachashan orayyta, kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 7:10) dovev sifte yeshenim. ad kan. <small>vehaya keetz shatul vechulei ad keilu kiyyem vehagita bo yomam valayla, umikkan telech Vayikra 263 amud alef shema yisrael.</small>
Patach veamar (Shemot 25:2) veyikchu li teruma, hacha ihu yichuda bichlala chada. ella vetatta. veyikchu teruma la ketiv, ella veyikchu li teruma, ella vetatta bichlala chada, belo piruda kelal.

Meet kol ish asher yiddevennu libbo tikchu et terumati. hay kera, hachi itzterich leh lememar, kol ish asher yiddevennu libbo, (sefer acher yikkach et terumati) may meet kol ish. ella raza hacha leinun mare midin. zakkain innun tzaddikayya, deyade leshavvaa reuta delibbehon legabbe malka illaa kadisha, vechol reuta delibbehon lav ihu legabbe alma da, uvechissufa batlla dileh. ella yade umishtaddele leshavvaa reutehon uleitdabbeka leella, begin leamshacha reuta (dilhon) demarehon legabbayyhu meella letatta.

Uman atar natle hahu reuta demarehon leamshacha leh legabbayyhu. natlin meatar chad illaa kadisha, deminneh nafkin kol reutin kaddishin. uman ihu. kol ish. da (42 amud bet) tzaddik, deitkere kol, kema deat amer (Kohelet Adonai:8) veyitron eretz bakkol hi. (Tehillim 119:128) al ken kol pikkude chol yishsharti. ish: kema deat amer (Bereshit 6:9) ish tzadik. da ihu tzadik, (sefer acher kol ish) mareh deveta, diruteh tadir legabbe matronita, kevalah derachim leitteh tadir. yiddevennu libbo ihu rachim lah. velibbo deihi matronita dileh, yiddevennu leitdabbeka beh.
Veaf al gav dirchimu sagi da beda, dela (Bereshit 7 amud alef) mitparshan lealmin, mehahu kol ish, mareh beta, marih dematronita, minneh tikchu et terumati. archeh dealma, man
767: Devae lenasseva itteteh debar nash minneh ihu kappid vela shavik lah. aval kudesha berich hu lav hachi, ketiv vezot hatteruma, zo keneset yisrael, af al gav dechol rechimu dilah legabbeh, urechimu dileh legavah. minneh natlin lah leashraa benayyhu, mehahu atar illaa, dechol rechimu deitteta uvaalah sharya. mittamman tikkechu et terumati, zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, vezakkain kullehu dezachu lehay.
(Shemot 25:3) vezot hatteruma asher tikchu meittam. vei tema, i hachi, asher tikchu meitto mibbae leh may meittam. meet teren shemahan (nusach acher dargin) illen.

Tu rav yeva sava amar, meittam: meat 40, deihu raza dealma illaa. atar madoreh dehay tzaddik, deihu itattar meat 60, umittamman natil (127 amud alef) chayyin, leatzena lealmin kullehu. vecholla milla chada, raza lechakkimin ityehivat, zakkaa chulakehon.

Deaf al gav deinnun natlin lah, (hacha) la yachlin lenattela lah, ella birshu devalah, uviru dileh, ulemebad pulechana dirchimu legabbeh, ucheden birchimu dileh tikchu et terumati. vechol da, beinnun pulechane ditzlota, vetikkuna vesiddura deyisrael mesadrin bechol yoma. davar acher meittam, mikkelala deshit sitrin illain vecholla chad.

(Davar acher) meittam, meinnun zimne veshavatte, vecholla raza chada. zahav vachesef unechoshet utechelet veargaman vetolaat shani. zahav, beraza deyoma derosh hashshana, deihu yoma dezahav, yoma dedina, veshalta hahu sitra, kema deat amer (Iyov 37:22) mitztzafon zahav yeete. vachesef, da yom hakkippurim, demitlabbenan chovehon deyisrael ketalga, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 1:18) im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu. uchetiv (Vayikra 16:30) ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem.

Unechoshet. yome dekarbenin dechag, deinnun retiche deammin ovde kochavim umazzalot, veinnun ikrun raza dehare nechoshet, uvegin kach mitmaatin bechol yoma veazlin. utechelet, da pesach, shuletanu deraza dimhemnuta, raza degavvna tichla, uvegin dehi tichla, la shalta ad deshetziat vekattilat kol buchere demitzrae, kema deat amer (Shemot 12:23) veavar Adonai lingof et mitzrayim. begin kach, kol (139 amud alef) gavvnin tavin bechelma, bar min tichla.

Veargaman, da shevuot, raza deargevavna, detora shebbichtav deityehivat beh, kelila mitteren sitrin, mimina umissemala, kema deat amer (Devarim 33) mimino esh dat lamo, veda ihu argaman. vetolaat shani, da ihu 15 beav, divnot yisrael havo nafke bemane millat, kema deat amer (Eicha 4:Adonai) haemunim ale tola.

Ad hacha, shit sitrin, mikkan ulehala raza dey yeme teshuva. veshesh, veizzim, veorot elim meaddamim. veorot techashim. vaatze shittim. veshemen lammaor. uvesamim leshemen hammishcha uliktoret hassammim. veavne shoham. veavni milluim. ad hacha tisha, lokovel tisha yomin veyom hakkippurim ashlim laasara.

Umikkol illen, anan natlin terumat Adonai, bechol zimna vezimna, begin leashraa alan. berosh hashshana anan natlin terumat Adonai, veihu raza derosh hashshana, deatya missitra dezahav. beyom hakkippurim anan natlin lah, veihi yom hakkippurim (emor 102) deyarta beratta leimma. bassukkot anan natlin lah, veihi sukka sochechet veaginat alan, uchetiv (Bamidbar 29:35) bayyom hashshemini atzeret tihye lachem veda ihi terumat Adonai.

Bafesach uf hachi anan natlin lah, veihi pesach. veha okimna, raza degavevn dinhora tichla. beshavuot anan natlin lah, veihi shete hallechem. uchetiv (Shemot 20:1) vaydabber elohim et kol haddevarim haelle lemor, vaanan natlin mittora shebbichtav, tora shebbeal pe. 15 beav, ihu kayyeyma bechedva, al benot yisrael. kol shear yomin, innun letikkuna dilah. veal da asher tikchu meittam ketiv.

Kegavvna deinnun mityaychadin leella beechad, uf hachi ihi, ityachadat letatta beraza deechad, lemehve immehon leella chad lokovel chad, kudesha berich hu echad leella, la yativ al kuresyay dikareh, ad deihi itavidat beraza deechad kegavvna dileh, lemeheve echad beechad. veha (134 amud alef) okimna raza daAdonai echad ushemo echad.
Raza deshabbat, ihi shabbat, deitachada beraza
768: Deechad, lemishre alah raza deechad. tzelota demaale shabbeta, deha itachadat kuresyay yakkira kaddisha, beraza deechad, veittakkanat lemishre alah malka kaddisha illaa.

Kad ayel shabbeta, ihi ityachadat veitparshat missitra achara, vechol dinin mitabberin minah, veihi ishtearat beyichuda dinhiru kaddisha, veitatterat bechamma itrin legabbe malka kaddisha, vechol shuletani rugezin umare dedina kullehu arkin, (nusach acher veitavaru minna) velet shuletanu achara bechullehu almin.

Veanpaha nehirin binhiru illaa, veitatterat letatta beamma kaddisha, vechullehu mitatterin benishmatin chadtin. keden sheruta ditzlota, levarcha lah bechedva, binhiru deanpin, velomar barchu et Adonai hamevorach. et Adonai dayyka, begin lemiftach legabbah bivracha.

Veasir leamma kadisha lemiftach legabbah bifsuka dedina, kegon vehu rachum vegomer, begin deha itparshat meraza desitra achara, vechol mare dedinin itparshu veitabberu minah. uman deittear hay letatta, garim leatara hachi leella. vechurseyay kadisha la yachla leitattera baatara dikdushsha, dechol zimna demitare letatta innun marehon dedina, dahavo mitabberin vahavu azle kullehu leittammera go nukeba deafra dithoma rabba, kullehu tayyvin leashraa beduchetayyhu veitrachakat (vaatadechaket) behu atar kadisha devaat nayycha.

Vela tema deda ihu bilchodoy, ella let itaruta leella leatara, ad deyisrael mitare letatta, kema deukimna, dichtiv, (Tehillim 81:4) bakkese leyom chaggenu. leyom chag la ketiv, ella leyom chaggenu. veal da asir leamma kadisha, deka mitatterin beitrin kaddishin denishmatin, begin leatara nayycha, deinnun yitarun dina, ella kullehu biru urechimu sagi, deyitarun birkan ella vetatta kachada.

Barchu et Adonai. et dayyka. kidkamran, da (Bereshit Adonai amud bet) shabbat demaale shabbatta. baruch Adonai hamevorach, da appiku devirchan mimmekora dechayye, vaatar denafik minneh kol shakyu, leashkaa lecholla. uvegin deihu mekora beraza deat kayyeyma, karenan leh hamevorach, ihu mabbua devera. kevan dematu tamman, ha vadday bera itmalleya, dela paskin memoy lealmin.

Veal da la amrenan, baruch et Adonai hamevorach, ella baruch Adonai, deilmale la mate hatam neviu mimmekora illaa, la itmalleya bera kelal, veal da hamevorach, amay ihu hamevorach. begin deihu ashlim veashke leolam vaed. olam vaed da ihu shabbat demaale shabbatta, vaanan takin birkan beatar deikre mevorach. vechevan dematan hatam, kullehu leolam vaed, veda ihu baruch Adonai hamevorach. ad hacha, matun birkan mealma illaa, vechullehu leolam vaed, leitvarcha uleitshakaa, ulemehve shelim kedka yeot, malya michol sitrin.

Barucha: da (162 amud alef, ekev 271 amud alef) mekora illaa, dechol birkan nafkin minneh. vechad sihara ishtelim, karenan lah hachi legave tattae, aval baruch mekora illaa kidkamran. Adonai: da emtzai dechol sitrin illain. hamevorach: da shelama deveta, mabbua devera, leashlama uleashkaa kolla. leolam vaed: da alma tattaa, deitzterich leitbarcha. umishcha urevu devaruch Adonai vehamevorach, kolla ihu leolam vaed. (mevorach kema deat amar 1 ben porat)

Veal da, beracha da, itzterichu kol amma levarcha, uvemaale shabbatta, biru deliva, uvechedva bau lemishre besheruta bivracha da, leitbarcha hay shabbat demaale shabbatta, (lelya) meamma kadisha kedka yeot. behay beracha.

(Sefer acher barchu) kad sharan yisrael levarcha, kala azla bechullehu rekiin, demitkaddeshe bikdushsha demaale shabbatta. zakkain attun amma kadisha, deattun mevarche umekaddeshe letatta, begin deyitbarchun veyitkaddeshun leella, kamma mashreyayn
769: Illain kaddishin, zakkain innun behay alma, vezakkain innun bealma deate, vela mevarche yisrael beracha da, ad demitatteran beitrin denishmatin kaddishin kidkamran. zakkaa amma dezakke lon bealma den, lemizke lon lealma deate.

Behay lelya shimmusha dechakkimin, beillen nishmatin kaddishin demitatteran behu, veaf al gav deha okimna vecholla chad. uvechol atar detishkach lechakkimin behay milla, besitra da, ulezimnin besitra da, kolla ihu chad. vehane mille ha okimna, aval bezimna da, demitatteran kullehu benishmatin veruchin chadtin yeterin kaddishin, keden ihi zimna deshimmusha dilhon, begin deliheve negidu lehahu shimmusha, bingidu dikdusha, benayycha illaa, veyifkun benayyhu kadishin kadka chazi.

Raza da lechakkimin ityeyhivat. beshaatta deitpelig lelya, belelya da, kudesha berich hu bae leaala beginta dilella. veraza da, beyome (Vayikra 49 amud bet) dechol kudesha berich hu al beginta deeden diltatta, leishtashea im tzadikayya desharan tamman, uveshabbat, behahu lelya deshabbeta, kudesha berich hu al beginta dilella, beraza dimkora illaa.

Begin divyome dechol, kol nishmatin detzadikayya kullehu, beginta di beara sharyayn. vechad itkaddash yoma bemaale shabbatta, kol innun mashreyayn demalachin kaddishin di memanan go ginta diltatta, kullehu sallekin lehane nishmatin, desharyayn go ginta diltatta, leaala legabbe hahu rekia dekayyeyma al ginta, umittamman izdamnu retichin kadishin, desacharan kurese yekara demalka, vesallekin lon lechol innun nishmatin, beginta dilella.
Kevan deillen ruchin sallekin, keden ruchin (98 amud bet, shalach 173 amud alef) acharanin kaddishin, nachtin, leitattera behu amma kaddisha. illen sallekin, veillen nachtin.

Vei tema, ha ginta divara, beyoma deshabbeta yatva berekanayyay bela nishmatin detzaddikayya. lav hachi. ella nishmatin azlin, venishmatin atyayn. nishmatin sallekin, venishmatin nachtin. nishmatin azlin miggo ginta, venishmatin atyayn lego ginta. kol innun nishmatin detzaddikayyay, demitlabbenan beyome dechol, vead la alu lego ginta, beshaata deillen nafkin, illen alin veginta la (253 amud alef) ishtear berekanyya. beraza delechem happanim beyom hillakcho.

Vei tema, kad ahadru beyome dechol. bema (nusach acher kema) itmashshechan duchete learka ufuteya veruma, beginta, vela ityeda. kegavvna deraza deeretz hatztzevi, dehava itmeshshach lechol sitrin vela ityeda. kegavvna ditzvi, dechol ma deitrabbe, mashkeh itrabbe lechol setar, vela ityeyda. veit kema nishmatin, dechevan desallekin, tu la nachtin.

Nishmatin sallekin, venishmatin nachtin, leitattera behu amma kaddisha. uvemaale shabbatta, gilgula denishmatin ihu, illen azlin, veillen atyayn, illen sallekin veillen nachtin. man chame kamma retichin kaddishin, di meshattete lechan ulechan. kullehu bechedva, kullehu biru, beillen nishmatin leattera leamma kaddisha, leattera lechamma tzaddikayyay, ginta deeden letatta, ad shaata decharoza kaim, vekare mekudash mekudash. keden nayycha shechiach, ushechichu lecholla. vechayyayve gehinnam kullehu mishtachche beduchetayyhu, veit lon nayycha. venishmatin kullehu mitatteran, illen leella veillen letatta. zakkaa amma, dechulaka da lehon.

Befalgut lelya demaale shabbatta, dechakkimin mitarin leshimmusha dilhon, hahu rucha illaa, demitatteran beh, kad yoma itkaddash, beshaata deinnun nayyme bearsayyhu, venishmatin acharanin dilhon, baan lesalleka lemechome bikara demalka, keden hahu ruach illaa denachit bemaale shabbatta, natil hahi nishmeta, vesallekin leella, veitsachya nishmeta achara bevusemin deginta deeden, vetamman chame ma dechame.
Vechad nachta leashraa beduchetaha befalgut lelya, hahi nishmeta tavat leduchetaha. uvae leinun
770: Chakkimin lomar, chad pesuka deitaruta, dehahu rucha illaa kaddisha deatra deshabbatta, kegon, (Yeshayahu 61:1) ruach Adonai elohim alay yaan mashach Adonai, oti levasser anavim vegomer. (Yechezkel 1:21) belechtam yelechu uveamdam yaamodu uvehinnasam meal haaretz vegomer, el asher yihye sham haruach lalechet yelechu vegomer. begin demitatteran behahu rucha, beitaruta dilhon bechedva deshimmusha, viyhe negidu dehahu ruach illaa deshabbatta, behahu shimmusha demitzva.

Rav hamenuna sava, kad hava (24 amud alef) salik minnahara bemaale shabbatta, hava yativ riga chada, vezakif enoy, vahava chadde, vahava amar, dehava yativ, lemecheme chedva demalache illae. illen sallekin, veillen nachtin. uvechol maale shabbatta, yativ bar nash baolam hanneshamot. zakkaa ihu man deyada berazin demareh.

Kad nahir yemama beyoma deshabbatta, seliku dechedva salik (Bereshit 8 amud alef) bechullehu almin, benayycha bechedva. keden (Tehillim 19:2) hashshamayim mesapperim kevod el umaase yadav maggid harakia. man shamayim. illen shamayim, dishma illaa itchaze behu, dishma kaddisha itreshim behu.
Mesapperim, may mesapperim, i tema keman demishtae sippur devarim. lav hachi. ella denaharin unetzitzin bintzitzu dinhora illaa, vesallekin bishma, dechalil binhiru dishlimu illaa.

Uman ihu sippur. denatztzetze binhiru dishlimu desefer illaa. uvegin kach, sallekin bishma shelim, venaharin binhiru shelim, venatztze bintzitzu shelim. inhu menatztze venahare begarmayyhu, miggo nehiru dintzitzu desefer illaa, venatztze venahare lechol setar usetar (nusach acher lechol kevod vechavod) demitdabbekan beh, deha minnayyhu, mehahu sefiru unehiru, nahir kol izka veizka, venatzitz bintzitzu, begin dibbehay yoma mitatteran shamayim, vesallekin bishma kaddisha, yattir mishshear yomin.
Umaase yadav, hahu talla illaa, denahir mikkol sitrin genizin, deihu maase yadav, vetikkuna dileh, demittatkena beyoma da mikkol shear yomin.

Maggid harakia. may maggid. mashich venagid letatta, meresha demalka, malya mikkol sitroy. harakia, hahu rakia, deihu mabbua devera. veda ihu hahu nahar denafik meeden, veda ihu denagid umashich letatta, negidu detalla illaa, denahir venatzitz bintzitzu mikkol sitrin. veda rakia angid leh bimshichu dirchimu vetiuveta, leashkaa shakyu dechedva, lemaale shabbatta.
Vechad nagid umashich hahu talla divdolcha, kolla (nagid) malya ushelim beatvoy kaddishin, bechol innun shevilin kaddishin. kevan decholla itchabbar beh, itavid beh archa leashkaa ulevarcha letatta.

Yom leyom: yoma leyoma, veizka leizka. hasheta mishtae kera beorach perat, hech shamayim mesapperim umetakkenin bisfiru uvintzitzu illaa lehay kavod, vehech nagid umashich hahu rekia, negidu detalla illaa. veamar, yom leyom yabbia omer. yoma leyoma, vedarga ledarga, yechavve (sefer acher ochez) leitkallela da beda, uleitnahara da min da, mehahu sefiru dimnatztzetze umenahare shamayim, lehay kavod. yabbia: kema deat amer mabba itavid vegomer. ochu leanhara da min da, uleitnatztzetza da min da, mehahu sefiru unetzitzu.

Yechavve. daat, yechavve: yechayye. yechayye toladin, deinnun (nusach acher beinnun) shamayim. vei tema, yechavve lav yechayye. ta chaze, ketiv (Bereshit 3:20) vayyikra haadam shem ishto chavva, ki hi hayta em kol chay. chavva vechayya bemilla chada sallekin. veal deistallak (nusach acher da istallak) 10, veayil 6, deihu kedka yeot, deha 6 ihu chayyin vadday, veal da chavva vechayya, 10 (sefer acher zeera netila) natla chayyin min 6. uf hacha, yechavve, yechayye.

Daat: da ihu raza deshamayim. ma shamayim shit sitrin, uf hacha shit sitrin, beinnun toladin deka yechayye kegavvna dileh, veal da yom leyom itkelil bedarga illaa omer. velayla lelayla beraza didchura, deka nahir lah deihu shemeh (nusach acher 390) daat.

Uvegin dehay omer raza illaa ihu, vela kishar amiran, ahdar kera aleh veamar, en omer veen devarim, kishar amiran dealma. ella hay omer, raza illaa ihu, bedargin illain, delet tamman amiran udevarim, vela ishtemau, kishar dargin deinnun raza dimhemnuta, deinnun kala demishtema, aval hane la (Bereshit 50) ishtemau lealmin, vehayeynu dichtiv beli nishma kolam.

Aval bechol haaretz yatza kavvam, af al gav deinnun temirin illain, dela ityeydau lealmin, negidu umeshichu dilhon, itmeshach veitnegid letatta. uvegin hahu meshichu, it lan mehemnuta shelemata, behay alma, vechol beni alma mishtau raza dimhemnuta dekudesha berich hu, beinnun dargin, keillu itgalleyayn, vela havo temirin ugenizin, vehayeynu uviktze tevel millehem, meresha dealma, ad sayyfe alma mishtaan innun chakkime libba, beinnun dargin genizin, af al gav dela ityeydau.

Aval bema ishtemodan, begin delashshemesh sam ohel bahem, begin shimsha kaddisha, deihu mashkena meinnun dargin illain kaddishin, veihu nehora, denatil kol nehorin genizin, vehahu meshichu dilhon, uvegineh itchaze mehemnuta bechol alma.

Man denatil leshimsha, keman denatil lechullehu dargin. begin deshimsha ihu ohel deitkelil behon, venatil kolla, veihu nahir lechol innun gevavne nehorin letatta. veal da vehu kechatan yotze mechuppato, binhiru unetzitzu dechol nehorin genizin, dechullehu betiuveta biruta shelim, yahave leh reutayyhu unehiru dilhon, kema dilchatan it reu vetiuveta dechalla (nusach acher dechullehu) lemehav lah nevizbezan umattenan. veal da vehu kechatan yotze mechuppato.

Man chuppato. da eden. veraza da, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden. eden, da ihu chuppa dechafya al kolla. yasis kagibbor. yasis, missitra deor kadmaa dela ishtechach beh dina kelal. kegibbor, missitra digvura, veaf al gav digvura ihi dina shelim, kegibbor ketiv, vela gibbor, begin deamtik dina bechesed, venatil kolla kachada, betiuveta ureuta shelim. vechol da, larutz orach. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 43:16) hannoten bayyam darech leashkaa uleashlema nehiru desihara bechol sitrin, (215 amud alef) ulemiftach bah orach leanhara letatta.

Miktze hashshamayim motzao, missayyfe illen shamayim illain dekaamaran, ihu appik, begin divsiyyuma degufa, ihu appik, uvehahu atar ishtemoda ben dechar lenukeba. veda hu dichtiv, (Devarim 4:32) ulemiktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim. ketze hashshamayim da (Rabbi amud alef) alma illaa. ulemiktze hashshamayim, da (malka 4) shelama dileh. kema dehay natil kol nehorin, vechullehu beh, uf hachi hay, natil kol nehorin, vechullehu beh, veihu nafik mikketze hashshamayim.

772: Leitnahara uleitshakaa ulenatztzetza minneh. veen nistar, let man deitchafya mehahu nehiru, deha lechullehu anhir bichlala chada, lechol chad vechad kema deitchaze leh.

Vechad kullehu ishtelimu veitnehiru miggo shimsha, keden sihara mitattera begavvna deimma illaa, shelema ben tarin, veda ihu dichtiv torat Adonai temima, deha keden ihi (shelema) temima, mikkol sitrin, beraza dachamesh dargin, kegavvna deima illaa, deinnun chamesh raza dechamshin.

Uvegine kach, ihi atya bachamesh chamesh tevin, begin leashlema leraza dechamshin. torat Adonai temima meshivat nafesh, ha chamesh. edut Adonai neemana machkimat peti, ha chamesh. pikkude Adonai yesharim mesammeche lev, ha chamesh. mitzvat Adonai bara meirat enayim, ha chamesh. yirat Adonai tehora omedet laad, ha chamesh. mishpete Adonai emet tzadku yachdav, ha chamesh. vechullehu atyayn bachamesh chamesh, leitkallela kegavvna deimma illaa.

Veal da, Adonai Adonai shit zimnin, lokovel shit sitrin illain, deinnun raza dishma illaa, (nusach acher dishmayya illain) veal da, sihara itmalleya veishtelim besiddura illaa kedka yeot, veda ihu beyoma deshabbatta, decholla ishtelim kedka yeot, beraza deshabbatta ella vetatta.

Veal da beyoma da, ittosaf nehiru becholla, kidkamran. shamayim natle mimmekora dechayye bekadmita, veinnun menahare umetakkene lichvod illaa, meraza (Bereshit 35 amud bet) desefer illaa, abba decholla. umeraza desefer, imma illaa. veihu, meraza desippur. uvegin kach, mesapperim, kidkamran. beraza ditlat shemahan illen, deshaltin beyoma deshabbatta, al kol shear yomin.

Uvegine kach tushebachta da, kaamar david beruach kudsha, al nehiru unetzitzu veshuletanu (nusach acher ushelimu) deyoma deshabbatta al kol shear yomin (sefer acher vetikkuna dileh deittatkenat beyoma da mikkol shear yomin) begin raza dishma illaa, deka nahir binhiru, venatzitz bintzitzu, veishtelim bishlimu ella vetatta. ucheden torat Adonai temima, shabbat demaale shabbatta, (sefer acher raza deshamor kevod layla deha hi torat Adonai temima tora shebbeal pe moshe kibbel tora missinay veha ittearu al tora shebbeal pe deillu tora shebbichtav ha ketiv vaytzav masheraz et haleviyyim vegomer lakoach et sefer hattora. veda lelevae itchaze lehay deachid beshimsha umalka daatayya minneh moshe nahir leyisrael 40 shenin shimsha beyomoy vetorat Adonai da mealay shabbeta) beraza chada kidkamran.

Veatkinu (sefer acher anshe keneset haggedola) chavrayyay sheruta detushebachte, meinnun tushebachtan dedavid, meraza da hashshamayim, deihu natil berisha, venahir lechol shear. ulevatar hahu nahar denafik meeden, veda ihu raza, (Tehillim 33:1) rannenu tzaddikim baAdonai begin dehay nahar kanish venatil kolla meraza deshamayim, beraza illaa, umekora dechayye, kolla kedka yeot beyoma da. veshimsha atkin leanhara kedka yeot, beyoma da.

Ulevatar sihara deka mitparshat missitra achara beyoma da, begin leitnahara min shimsha, veda ihu ledavid beshannoto et tamo vegomer. ulevatar deitparshat minneh, ha itchabberat beshimsha. vetushebachta da bechv atvavn, deail bah shimsha besihara. vetushebachta da, perishu desihara missitra achara, vetushebachta dechv atvavn binhiru deshimsha.

Ulevatar itchabberuta useliku dematronita im balah. veda ihu (Tehillim 90:1) tefilla lemoshe ish haelohim. itchabberuta veitdabbekuta deitteta bevalah, lefarsa yemina usemala lekabbela lah, ulemeheve kachada bechibbura chada. (lemeheve chad beraza chad. vechol illen shamayim mesapperim lon umetakkenin lon. mikkan ulehala tushebchan acharanin dechedva vetiuveta shelemata. aval hane inun tikkuna shelemata illaa beraza dishma kaddisha kedka yeot vetushebchan illen atkinu betikkuna deshabbat deihu salik veitattar beitroy kedka yeot vesallekin beraza dishma kaddisha lemaher chad beraza dechavod el deshamayim mesapperim leh vazehareyn leh kidkamran)

773: Parot alot kad havo natle arona, ittearu behay tushebachta, kema deat amer (Shmuel 1 6:12) vayyishsharna happarot badderech. uma shira havo amre. Vetushebachta da, kad natle arona, ka meshabbechan lah. kad sallekin levet shemesh. kegavvna daagalot sallekin levet shemesh. vecholla beraza chad salkin, begin divshabbat ihu seliku dechuresyyay, lesalleka leella. tikkuna detushebachta da beshabbat illen tushebchan kullehu atkinu beshabbat, leshabbecha leh amma yechida bealma.

(Tehillim 92:1) mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat, tushebachta da, adam harishon kaamar lah, beshaata deittarach migginta deeden, veata shabbat veagin aleh. veukemuha chavrayyay, tushebachta da, alma tattaa ka meshabbach legabbe alma illaa, yoma (decholla beh) deihu kullo shabbat, malka, dishlama dileh. veda ihu mizmor shir, vela ketiv man kaamar leh, kema deokimna.

Leyom hashshabbat, yoma illaa, shabbat illaa. da shabbat veda shabbat, ma ben hay lehay. ella, shabbat setam, da shabbat demaale shabbatta. yom hashshabbat, da shabbat dilella. da yom, veda layla. (Shemot 31:16) veshamru veni yisrael et hashshabbat, ha lelya, raza denukeba. (shamevatek) zachor et yom hashshabbat, ha yom, raza didchura. uvegin kach mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat.

Veashkechan bechamma atar, dealma tattaa la salik bishma, veatya (Vayikra 102) setam, kegon hay, uchegon vayyikra el moshe, uchegon (Shemot 24:1) veel (131 amud alef) moshe amar ale el Adonai. kullehu satim shema, vela salik beh. 774: Vechol shevacha da, vechol millin illen, kullehu shayyfin yedian, bechushebana letashluma deshabbat, uleishtallema minnayyhu, kadka chazi. zakkaa amma, deyade lesaddera shevacha demarehon, kadka yeot. mikkan ulehala siddura ditzlota kema deittaknat.

Ketiv (Tehillim 22:20) veatta Adonai al tirchak eyaluti leezrati chusha. david malka amar da, beshaata dehava metakken umesadder tushebachta demalka, begin lechabbera shimsha besihara. kevan dehava metakken umesadder shevachin dileh leitchabbera, amar veatta Adonai al tirchak.

Veatta Adonai raza (251 amud alef, 140 amud alef, 179 amud bet) dechavruta chada belo piruda. al tirchak, kevan deihi salleka leitattera bevalah, vecholla bealma illaa, umittamman bae lesalleka leen sof, leitkashshera kolla leella leella, ubbegin kach al tirchak, leistalleka minan, leshavka lan.

Uvegin kach, bego siddura detushebachta, baan yisrael leitkallela tamman, uleitdabbeka bahadayyhu mittatta, deilmale yive leistalleka hay kavod, ha yisrael letatta achidan beh vetakfin beh, dela shavke leh leitrachaka minnayyhu. veal da tzelota belachash, keman demallil beraza im malka, uveod deihu beraza immeh, la itrachaka minneh kelal.

Eyaluti, ma ayyal utzevi, beshaata deazle umerachake, miyyad ahadran lehahu atar deshavke, uf kudesha berich hu, af al gav deistallak leella leella been sof, miyyad ahdar leatreh. may tama. begin deyisrael letatta itachadan beh, vela shavkin leh leitnashsheya, (minneh) uleitrachaka minnayyhu. veal da, eyaluti leezrati chusha.

Uvegin kach baenan leitachada beh bekudesha berich hu, uleachada beh, keman deamshich meella letatta, dela yishtevak bar nash minneh, afillu shaata chada. veal da kad samich geula litfilla, bae leachada beh, uleishtae bahadeh bilchishu, beraza, dela yitrechak minan, vela yishtebak minan, veal da ketiv (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kulchem hayyom. (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo ashre haam sheAdonai elohav.

Behahi shaata, kam rabbi shimon vechavrayya uf hachi kamu veazlu. amar rabbi elazar lerabbi shimon avuy, abba, ad hacha havena yatve betzilla deilana dechayye beginta deeden. mikkan ulehala deanan azlin, itzterich lan lemehach bearchoy denatran ilana da. amar leh, ant tishre besheruta lemiftach bearcha.

Patach veamar, (Shemot 25:2) veyikchu li teruma, kema deittemar. bemay ihi teruma. beraza dezahav, deha mittamman itteznat bekadmita, begin deihi gevura tattaa, deatya missitra dezahav. veaf al gav deatya missitra dezahav, kol ikar la ishtearat, ella besitra dechesef, deihu yemina.

(sefer acher usemala itade minna velo vechulei) usemala ittear yemina, vela itdevak beh, begin deihu ityeyhiv ben yemina usemala, usemala itachid techoteh, vimina itachid beh leella, kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni. zahav vachesef, kema deat amer (Chagai 2:8) li hakkesef veli hazzahav, veha ittemar.

Unechoshet, da ihu gon kegavvna dezahav, begin deitzteba miggavevn zahav umiggavevn dechesef. veal da mizbach hannechoshet katan. amay ihu katan. kema deat amer (Melachim 1 8:64) ki hammizbeach asher lifne Adonai katon mehachil et haola vegomer. kema deat amer (Shmuel 1 17:14) vedavid hu hakkatan. veaf al gav deihu katan, kolla itachid begavveh. vei tema mizbeach achara, ikre katan. lav hachi. delav katan bar hay, dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:16) et hammaor haggadol lememshelet hayyom veet hammaor hakkatan lememshelet hallayla. veda ihu hammaor hakkatan. hammaor haggadol, da mizbeach happenimi deihu mizbach hazzahav.
775: Da ihu techelet detzitzit. techelet da ihu kurseyay, raza ditfilla deyad. techelet da ihu kurseyay, dedayynin beh dini nefashot. begin deit kurseyay dedayynin beh dini mamonot, veit kurseyay dedayynin beh dine nefashot. veal da, kol gavvnin (135 amud alef, 152 amud alef, Bereshit nusach acher amud bet) tavin lechelma, bar gon tichla, begin deyinda deha nishmateh salka bedina. vechad nishmeta salka bedina, gufa ittedan leishtetzaa veitzterich hahu chelma, lerachamin saggiin.

Techelet da ihu kurseyay, dichtiv beh (Yechezkel 1:26) kemare even sappir demut kisse, (uchetiv veesh mitlakkachat) uchetiv venoga lo saviv. begin deavdin beh kerichin letzitzit, vechad noga lo, ithaddar legavvn yarok, kegaven karti. mehahi shaata veelech, ishtere zimna dikriat shema, deha ishtani gon tichla mikkema dehava, uvegin kach asir lemedan dine nefashot ballayla, begin deshalta hahu gon tichla behahu zimna, veityehiv reshu lemechotaf nafsha belo mishpat. deha mishpat la shalta behahu zimna.

Kad ate tzafra, veittear yemina dilella, nafik hahu nehora, umate ad hay tichla, veishtane mikkema dehava, ucheden shalta aleh, veitdabbak beh kurseyay achara kaddisha. mehahi shaata veelech, zimna dikriat shema.

Veargaman, da kenufeya dichalila kol gevavnin kachada. vetolaat shani, ketiv shani, uchetiv shanim, dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:21) ki chol beta lavush shanim. ella hay ihu gon ikre shani, denatil kol gavvnin beh, vecholla ihu chad, shani veshanim. shanim: kad kullehu kelilan beh kachada. shani: denafik mikkurseyay illaa, deshalleta al techelet missitra dimina, veda ihu appotropposa deyisrael, dichtiv beh (Daniel 10:21) michael sarechem. tolaat: decheleh befumeh, kattolaat, dimtabbar kolla veoker kolla.

Tolaat shani vashesh, teren gavvnin kachada, dimina usemala, chivvar vesumak. vashesh: butza ihu. deshit chutin mitchabberan, veda ihu dichtiv, (Daniel 10:6) ugeviyyato chetarshish. uveillen teren, kelilan teren acharanin.

Veizzim: gevuran tattae dilvar, lechafya al penimae. vecholla itzterich, veitzterich lemehav ducheta lecholla, deha missitra dedahava kaatyayn. veorot elim meaddamim, meshichu ditren sitrin, dimina usemala, lechafyay beducheta achara.
Veorot techashim, sitra chada it derabbe go sitra achara bechureba, vela beyishshuva ishtechach, veda ihu sitra dachyu, veikre tachash.

Besifra deshlomo malka it go hay mizbach hannechoshet dekamran, razin illain. deha mizbach adama ketiv, (Shemot 20:21) mizbach adama taase li vegomer veda ihu raza kedka yeot. nechoshet, kad shaltin turin acharanin, veihi tzericha lemezan lon, itzteba behay gon lemezan lon. veinnun ikrun hare nechoshet.

Veinnun (260 amud alef) hare nechoshet itmeshach alayyhu rucha chada miggo hay mizbeach, vechad hay mizbeach istallak bisliku achara, keden istallak at 50, deihu mizbeach kaddisha, veishtear rucha deillen ture nechoshet. vechad hahu rucha istelik bekiyyumeh, ikre tachash, deha istallak minneh at 50.

Vehay itperash, lechamma ruchin acharanin, veikrun uf hachi, veal da ikre hahu amma, tachash. kema deat amer (Bereshit 22:24) veet (147 amud bet) tachash veet maacha. innun havo yade beha chayya demashkena, deikre al shemehon.
Vaatze shittim, illen innun razin kaddishin, deinnun luche mashkena, veinnun ikrun beraza dilhon. ketiv atze shittim omdim, uchetiv (Yeshayahu 6:2) serafim omdim.

Mikkan ulehala shemen lammaor, meshichu dimshach revut kaddisha leamshacha alayyhu. avne shoham veavni milluim, illen avne kudsha, yesode demakdesha, birtichin kaddishin illen, izdammenan bilchodayyhu, leyakker uleshabbecha, bilvush yekar, leayyeyna kahana behu tamman, uleadkera (ulevarcha) teresar shevatin, veal da teresar avanin kema deittemar.
Telesar zinin innun, bar 12 avnin yakkirin illen, vechullehu sallekin lech atvavn,
776: Beraza illaa deyichuda. velokovel illen, galif veatkin moshe, 25 atvavn beraza difsuka deyichuda, dichtiv, (Devarim 6:4) shema yisrael yedod elohenu yedod echad. veinnun 25 atvavn, gelifan mechakkekan beraza dilella.

Yaakov baa leatkena letatta, beraza deyichuda, veatkin bechd atvavn, veinnun baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed. vela ashlim lech atvavn, begin dead la ittakkan mashkena. kevan deittakkan mashkena, veishtelim, milla kadmaa dehava nafik minne, kad ishtelim, la mallil ella bech atvavn, leachazaa deha ishtelim da kegavvna dilella, dichtiv, (Vayikra 1:1) vaydabber Adonai elav meohel moed lemor. ha 25 atvavn.

Veal da 25 zinin leashlema tikkuna demikdasha (sefer acher demashkena) vechol hane atvavn, okimna beinnun atvavn gelifan, deolifna mimmar. uvegin demashkena ishtelim berazin illen, ikre 25, beyichuda dishlimu demashkena, veal da (Tehillim 145:10) vachasidecha yevarchucha ketiv, raza dishlimu dechol mashkena vetikkuna dileh. 25, lokovel 22 atvavn, veorayyta uneviim uchetuvim, deinnun kelala chada, veraza chada.

Beshaata deyisrael ka meyachde yichuda behay kera, beraza dech atvavn, deinnun shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad, ubbaruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed, deinnun 24 atvavn, vichavvevn kol chad behu, kullehu atvavn mitchabberan kachada, vesallekin bechibbura chad (sefer acher keden itpattachu) 49 tarin, beraza deyovla. ucheden itzterich lesalleka ad vela yattir. ucheden itpattachu tarin, vechashiv kudesha berich hu lehahu bar nash, keillu kiyyem orayyta kulah, deihi atya bemt panim.

(Becholla) veal da itzterich lechavvevna libba ureuta bech uvechd, ulesalleka lon biruta delibba, lemt tarin dekamran. kevan deitkavvavn behay, yitkavvavn behahu yichuda deamar mar, shema yisrael ubbaruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed kelala dechol orayyta kullah. zakkaa chulakeh man deyitkavvavn behu, devadday kelala ihu dechol orayyta deella vetatta. veda ihu raza deadam shelema, didchar venukeba, veraza dechol mehemnuta.

Machaloket deshammay vehillel bekima uvishchiva, dichtiv, (Devarim 6:7) veshachbecha uvekumecha, deshammay savar baerev deka kelila nukeba beshultanaha, itzterich legabbe nukeba deka yattu veyikreu. uvabboker, deka shalta dechura beshuletanuta dealma illaa, itzterich lemekam kameh didchura, kema deitzterich bitfilla meumad, uvechol atar didchura atya.

Uvet hillel savar, ilmale ishtechach da lechod veda lechod, hachi itzterich. aval kevan daanan mechabberan lon kachada, bechibbura bemt panim, umt tarin, la itzterichna leafresha da lechod veda lechod, ella leashgecha decholla ihu chad, bela piruda. uchema deizdamman leh levar nash, hachi yema, deha tarvavyyhu bechibbura chada, kema denaycha lon, vehachi itzterich leitchazaa.

Veal da dechura, beshit sitrin, bakkera dishma yisrael, deinnun shit tevin. venukeba beshit sitrin baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed. deinnun shit tevin acharanin, vesallekin bechibbura chada, beraza demt tarin, vahalacha kevet hillel bechol atar.

Rabbi shimon arim yedoy uvarich lerabbi elazar bereh. patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 41:2) mi heir mimmizrach vegomer. hay kera okimna veittemar, aval raza dechachmeta ihu, mi raza dealma illaa ihu, deha mittamman nafka sheruta, leitgalya raza dimhemnuta, veha (behakedama 2 amud alef) okimna.

Tu. mi temira dechol temirin, dela ityeda vela itgalleyay kelal. galle yekareh leishtemoda, mehahu atar deikre mizrach, deha mittamman sheruta dechol raza dimhemnuta, unehora leitgalyay. ulevatar tzedek yikraehu leraglo, deha tzedek, galle gevureta illaa, veshuletanih dekudesha berich hu, ulehay tzedek ashlete al almin kullehu, ledabbera lon, uleatkena lon, kadka yeot. veal da, (Yeshayahu 41:2) yitten lefanav goyim umelachim yard,
777: Deha kol malchin dealma, birshuta dehay tzedek kayymin, kema deat amer (Tehillim 9:9) vehu yishpot tevel betzedek.

Tu, tzedek yikraehu leraglo, man kare leman. ella, tzedek ihu kare tadir leaspaklarya denahara, vela shachich lealmin, vetzedek kaim tadir leragloy, dela itade mittamman, vekare vela shachich, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 83:2) elohim al domi lach al techorash veal tishkot el. vehasheta kudesha berich hu anhar lan archa da beginan (206) elazar beri dekare linhora illaa vela shachich. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay bealma den uvealma deate. (sefer acher vehasheta elazar beri kare linhora illaa velo shachich vekudesha berich hu anehar lan archa da begineh, zakkaa chulakeh vezakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayya)

Ribbi abba patach kera veamar, (Tehillim 63:1) mizmor ledavid bihyoto bemidbar yehuda. may shena mikkol shear tushebchan, dela kaamar bean atar shabbach lon david malka, umay shena hacha dekaamar bihyoto bemidbar yehuda. ella la da bilchodoy, deha uf hachi namme, (tehillim la) beshannoto et tamo lifni avimelech. (Tehillim 54:2) bevo hazzifim. vechen kullehu. leachazaa lechol bene alma, shevacheh dedavid, deaf al gav divtzaara hava, vahavu radfe avatreh, hava mishtaddal lomar shirin vetushebchan lekudesha berich hu.

Veaf al gav divruach kudsha hava amar, ruach kudsha la have share aloy, ad deihu ishtaddal lemishre aloy. vechen bechol atar, la sharya ruach kudsha dilella, ad deyittear aleh bar nash mitatta. vedavid af al gav deka radfe avatreh, vahava betzaareh, la hava shavik shirin vetushebchan mippumeh, uleshabbecha lemareh al kolla.

Vei tema, ha detanenan, (Bereshit 39 amud bet, 65 amud alef) mizmor ledavid, o ledavid mizmor, vehacha sharat aleh ruach kudsha bekadmita, begin deamar mizmor ledavid. ella, i ihu la hava mechavven garmeh bekadmita, la sharat aleh ruach kudsha.

(50 Amud alef, 238 amud bet) mizmor da ruach kudsha. amay ikre hachi. begin deihi, meshabbachat tadir lemalka illaa (sefer acher dechol zimna ihu ka meshubbach vamezamer velo shachich) dechol zimna hava ka meshabbechat umezammerat, vela shachich. kevan deata david ashkach (103 amud bet) gufa metatkena kadka yeot, vesharat aleh, vahavu megalle behay alma, leshabbecha ulezammera lemalka, vecholla, begin deyittekan hay alma, kegavvna dilella.

Ledavid. gevar shelim betikkunoy, gevar metakkana, gevar zakkaa. david vadday dela ishtane lealmin. bihyoto bemidbar yehuda, da shevacha dedavid, af al gav divtzaareh hava, af al gav dahavo radfe avatreh. umay tushebachta kaamar. tushebachta deihu rav veyakkira.

Ushevacha dileh may ihi. (Tehillim 63:2) elohim eli atta ashacharekka. elohim setam. kevan deamar elohim, amay eli. ella hahu darga dileh. telat dargin hacha: elohim. eli. atta. veaf al gav deinnun telat shemahan, chad darga ihu, beraza deelohim chayyim. elohim: leella, elohim chayyim. eli: ketze (Bereshit 1 amud bet) hashshamayim ad ketze hashshamayim. (138 amud bet) atta: darga dileh. veaf al gav decholla chad, uvishma chad salik.

Ashacharekka, i kemashmao dileh, shappir. aval ashacharekka, atkin nehora denahir beshachruta. deha nehora dekayyeyma beshachruta, la nahir ad deyittaknun leh letatta. uman deatkin nehora shachara da, af al gav deihi uchama, zache (Bereshit nusach acher amud bet) linhora chivvavra denahir, veda ihi nehora aspakalarya denahara, veda ihu bar nash dezache lealma deate.

Veraza da (Mishlei 8:17) umeshacharay yimtzaunni, umeshacharay: dimtakkenin nehora meshacharay uchama. yimtzaunni, yimtzauni la ketiv, ella yimtzaunni, dezache litren nehorin. linhora deshachara uchama, velinhora chivvavra denahara. vezache leaspakalarya dela nahir, uleaspakalarya denahir. veda ihu yimtzaunni. veal da amar david ashacharekka, atkin nehora deshachara uchama, lenahara aleh nehora chivvavra denahara.

(Tehillim 63:2) tzama lecha nafshi kama lecha vesari, keman dechafin lemechal vetzache lemishte. beeretz tziyya veayef beli mayim, begin deihu midbar, velav ihu atar deyishshuva, velav ihu atar dekudsha.
778: Uvegin kach ihu atar beli mayim. uchema deanan kafin vetzachan legabbach baatar da, ken bakkodesh chaziticha vegomer. vaanan kema deanan tzachan legabbe demar, lemishte betzachuta milloy baatar da, uf hachi tzachenan lemishte betzachuta milloy, beve makdesha, atar deikre kodesh. amar rabbi shimon lera abba, man deshari milla hasheta yema.

Patach ribbi abba veamar, (Shemot 25:2) veyikchu li teruma meet kol ish vegomer. moshe beshaata dekudesha berich hu achme leh ovada demashkena, hava kashe kameh, vela yachil lemekam beh, veha ukemuha. vehashsheta it lan lemikshe hacha, i teruma da, yahavah kudesha berich hu lemoshe bilchodoy, hech yahavah leachara, veamar delivne yisrael yikchu hay teruma.

Ella vadday lemoshe yahavah, vela yahavah leachara. lemalka dehava bego ammeh, vela havat matronita immeh demalka. kol zimna dematronita la havat immeh demalka, la mityyaashe amma beh, veinnun la yatvin lerachatzan. kevan deatat matronita, kol amma chadan, veyatve beruchetztzanu. kach bekadmita, af al gav dekudesha berich hu avad lon nissin veatin al yede demoshe, la mityaashe amma. kevan deamar kudesha berich hu veyikchu li teruma, venatatti mishkani betochchem. miyyad ityaashu kullehu, vechaddu befulechana dekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 7:1) vayhi beyom kallot moshe denachtat kallat moshe leara.

Vei tema, vayhi bechol atar lav ihu ella lishana detzaara, vehacha ketiv vayhi beyom. ella, behahu yoma dishchinta nachtat leara, ishtechach mekatrega legabbah, vechafya hahu chashuch keval legabbah, begin dela techot. vetanenan, elef vachamesh mea ribbo malachin mekatregin, ishtechachu legabbah begin dela techot.

Uvehahu zimna ishtechachu kol kenufeya demalache illae kame kudesha berich hu. amru kammeh, mare dealma, kol ziva vechol nehora dilan bishchinat yekarach ihu, vehasheta techot legabbe tattae. behahi shaata ittatkefat shechinta, vetavrat hahu chashuch keval, keman demittebar gezzizin takkifin, venachtat leara. kevan dechamu kullehu kach, patchu veamru (Tehillim 8:2) Adonai adonenu ma addir shimcha bechol haaretz. addir vadday, detavrat kama gezzizin vechelin takkifin, venachtat leara, ushelitat becholla. veal da ketiv vayhi, tzaara dekabbilu kama chayyaylin umashshiryayn, beyoma dechallat moshe nachtat leara.

Uvegin kach veyikchu li teruma vegomer. veyikchu li uteruma la ketiv, ella veyikchu li teruma, leachazaa decholla chad bela piruda. veovada demashkena kegavvna dilella, da lokovel da, leitkallela shechinta mikkol sitrin ella vetatta, hacha behay alma ovada dileh, keovada degufa, leitkallela rucha begavveh, veda ihi shechinta, deitkelilat leela vetatta, veihi ruach kudsha.

Uleolam itmashshechat vealat go raza degufa, leashraa mocha go kelifa kolla kema deitchaze. hay rucha dekudsha, itavid begufa, leitkallela begavvih ruach achara illaa, dakik venahir, vecholla hachi itachid veitkelil da beda, veal da beda, ad deitachid behay alma, deihu kelifa batraa dilvar.

Kelifa takkifa ihi lego miklifa dehay alma. kegavvna deegoza, dehay kelifa dilvar lav ihi takkifa, kelifa deihi lego minnah, ihi kelifa takkifa. uf hachi leella, kelifa takkifa, ihi rucha achara deshalta begufa. lego minneh, ihi kelifa kelisha. lego minneh mocha.

Beara kaddisha, metatkena kolla begavvna achara, deha kelifa takkifa ittabberat mehahu atar, vela shalta (173 amud alef) beh kelal. kelifa takkifa ittabberat tevir, (davar acher mehahu yoter tadir) veitpatchat mehay sitra (sefer acher ad deitteachid beraza demashkena. behay alma kelippa batraa ihi lakeraz kelippa takkifa ihi lego kegavvna da uf hacha leella kelippa takkifa ihi levar lego minneh ihi kelippa kelisha velo shalta beh kelal vaatapetachet mehay sitra) (59 amud bet) umehay sitra.
Vehahi petichu hava beara kaddisha, bechol zimna defalchin pulechana
779: Kedka yeot. kevan degarmu chovin, meshichu hahu petichu lehay sitra ulehay sitra, ad deitkarav kelifa, kolla kachada. kevan deastim kelifa lemocha, keden shalta (203 amud alef) hahi kelifa alayyhu vedacha lon levar mehahu ducheta.

Veim kol da af al gav dedacha lon levar, la yachil hahi kelifa takkifa leshalletaa behahu ducheta kaddisha, delav atreh ihu. vei tema, i hachi, hoil vela yachil hahi kelifa takkifa leshalletaa behahu ducheta kaddisha, amay kayyeyma charuv, deha charba la have bealma, ella missitra dehahi kelifa takkifa.

Ella vadday kad itcharav, la itcharav ella mehahu sitra, beshaata deastim lemocha, vekudesha berich hu aved dela tishlot hahi kelifa takkifa al hahu ducheta. vechad dacha lon leyisrael minneh, hahi kelifa ithadderat veitpatchat kemillekaddemin. uvegin (58, 78 amud bet) deamma kaddisha la havo tamman, chafya al hahu petichu, chuppaa kaddisha defarochta kelisha, lenatra hahu atar, dela yistom leh hahi kelifa takkifa, veachid bechol sitroy.

Lemeheve revut kudsha al ara kemilkaddemin, la yachil, deha hahu chuppaa kelisha achid, dela yechut letatta, deha amma kaddisha lav tamman. veal da la itbene charban, miyyoma deitcharivu. leshalletaa hahi kelifa takkifa, la yachla, deha hahu chuppaa kelisha achid beh bechol sitroy behahu petichu dela tishlot tamman, vela tastim mocha, behahu chuppaa defarochta kelisha, deihu miggo meshichu defarochta kaddisha dilella, denatir hahu atar.

Uvegin kach, kol innun nishmatin dishar ammin, dedayyrin beara, kad nafkin mehay alma, la mekabbela lon, vedache lon levar, veazlin veshatan umitgalgelin bechamma gilgulin, ad denafke mikkol ara kaddisha, vesacharan (lasevacheraneyyhav) lesitrayyhu, bimsaavu dilhon. vechol innun nishmatin deyisrael denafkin tamman, sallekin, vehahu chuppaa kelisha mekabbela lon, vealin likdushsha illaa, begin dechol zina azla lezineh.

Venishmatehon deyisrael denafke levar meara, birshuta dehahi kelifa takkifa, azla vesachara umitgalgela, ad detavat leduchetaha, vealat laatar deitchaze lah. zakkaa chulakeh, man denishmateh nafka birshu kaddisha, behahu petichu deara kaddisha.

Man denishmateh nafkat beara kaddisha, i itkebar behahu yoma, la shalta aleh rucha mesaava kelal. veal da ketiv bitzliva, (Devarim 21:23) ki kavor tikberennu bayom hahu velo tetamme et admatcha. begin divlelya ityehiv reshu leruach mesaava limshatteta. veaf al gav deityehiv lon reshu, la alin beara kaddisha, bar i ashkechan tamman mana leaala beh.

(130 Amud alef) evarin ufedarin demitakkelan belelya, leattezna zinin acharanin, lav deayylin beara, vela leamshacha lon beara, ella, begin dela tishlot sitra achara go ara, vela yitmashcha leaala tamman. uvegin kach, tenana minnayyhu hava salik (130 amud alef) akima, umitgalgela levar, veazil (takkif) bivhilu, ad deal lenukeba detzafon, detamman madorin dechol sitrin acharanin, vetamman al tenana, vechullehu ittezanu tamman.

Tenana dimama, hava salik leducheteh beorach meshar, veittezan ma deittezan. umehahu petichu, (109 amud bet) ittezanu kol sitre kelifa takkifa, deihi levar meara kaddisha, umehahi tenana gassa kema deokimna.

Gufehon detzaddikayyay, dela itmeshachu behay alma batar hanain dehahi kelifa takkifa, la shalta alayyhu ruach mesaavu kelal, deha la ishtatfu avatreh kelum behay alma. kema degufa derashiayyay (nusach acher gufehon detzaddikayyay dela itmashchu batar haneayn vechissufin dehay alma hahi kelippa takkifa lo shalta alayyhu deha lo itmashchu avatreh behay alma deha kema degufeh derashshiayya) itmeshach behay alma batar hahi kelifa takkifa, vahanain veinnugin dileh vetikkunin dileh, hachi isteav, batar denafkat nishmateh minneh.
780: Alma, ella mittaanuge demitzva, useudate shabbatin vechaggin uzemanin, hahu ruach mesaava la yachil leshaltaa alayyhu, deha la itannegu midileh kelum. vehoil vela natlu midileh, let leh reshu alehon kelal. zakkaa ihu man dela ithane midileh kelum.

Man denishmateh nafka levar meara kaddisha, vehahu gufa isteav behahu ruach mesaavu, hahu ruach mesaavu ishteiv begavvih, ad detav leh afra. (nusach acher daatabelay gufa beafra) vei hahu (Vayikra amud bet amud bet) gufa, deishteiv beh hahu ruach mesaava, sallekin leh leitkabbera go ara kaddisha, aleh ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:7) vattavou vattetammeu et artzi venachalati samtem letoeva. artzi, dela shalta alah ruach mesaavu, behahu gufa dilchon, deishteiv beh ruach mesaavu, deka mayytin lekavra leh beartzi, attun mesaavin lah, leistaava beh. i la deavid kudesha berich hu asvavta leara, deha kevan deitbale hahu gufa, nashiv kudesha berich hu rucha milleella, vedache leh lehahu ruach mesaava levar, deha ihu chas al areh.

Yosef, la shallit al gufeh ruach mesaava lealmin, af al gav denishmateh nafkat birshu achara. may tama. begin dela itmeshich bechayyyoy batar ruach mesaava. veim kol da, la baa degufeh yesallekun leh leitkabbera beara kaddisha, ella amar, (Bereshit 50:25) vehaalitem et atzmotay, vela gufi.

Yaakov la mit, vegufeh itkayyaym bekiyyuma tadir, vela dachil lesitra achara, deha arseh hava shelim, bishlimu dinhora illaa, binhiru ditresar shevatin, uveshivim nefesh, begin kach la dachil lesitra achara, vela yachil leshalletaa aleh. vetu, deihu gufa dediyyukena illaa, dishpiru dileh achid lechol sitrin, vechol innun shayyfin deadam kadmaa havo achidan beh. veal da ketiv beh, (Bereshit 47:30) veshachavti im avotay unesatani mimmitzrayim, gufa shelim. veal da vayyachantu harofim et yisrael, degufeh yehe kaim bekiyyuma. vehachi itzterich. shear bene alma denafkat nishmatayyhu beara kaddisha, nafsha vegufa ishtezziv mikkolla.

Telat shemahan ikre nishmeta devar nash, nefesh, rucha, venishmata. vechullehu kelilan da beda, uvitlat duchete ishtechach chelayyhu. nefesh da, ishtechachat go kivra, ad degufa itbele beafra, uveda mitgalgelat hay alma, leishtakkecha go chayyaya, uleminda betzaara dilhon, uveshaata di itzterichu, baat rachame alayyhu.

Rucha da, ihu deal beginta di beara, veitztayayr tamman, bediyyukena degufa dehay alma, bechad malbusha demitlabbesha tamman. veda ithane tamman bahanain vechissufin beziva divginta. uveshabbate veyarche uzemane, salleka leella, (136 amud alef, 99 amud bet) veithane tamman, vetav leatreh. veal da ketiv, (Kohelet 12:7) veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah. tashuv vadday, behane zimnin dekamran.

Neshama ihi salleka miyyad leatraha, lehahu atar denafkat mittamman, veda ihi divginah itnehirat butzina, leanhara leella. da la nachtat letatta lealmin, beda itkelilat, man deitkelilat mikkol sitrin meella umittatta. vead dehay la salleka leitkashshera (nusach acher beduchetaha) bechuresyyay, la mitattera ruach beginta di beara, venefesh la mityashsheva beduchetaha. kevan deihi salleka, kullehu it lehu nayycha.

Vechad itzterich livne alma, kad innun betzaara, veazle leve kivre, hay nefesh ittearat, veihi azla umeshatteta, veittearat leruach, vehahu ruach ittear legabbe avahan, vesalik veittear legabbe neshama, ucheden, kudsha berich hu chayyis al alma, veha okimna. veaf al gav deha ittearu millin illen denishmeta bigvavnin acharanin, kullehu sallekin bematkela, da, veda ihu berira demilla, vecholla chad.
Vechad nishmeta itakkevat milsalleka leduchetaha, rucha azla vekayyeyma befitcha deginta deeden, vela patchin lah pitcha,
781: Veazla umeshatteta, velet man deyishgach bah. nefesh azla umeshatteta bealma, chamat legufa desalleka tolain, uvehahu dina dekivra, umitabbelat aleh, kema deukemuha dichtiv, (Iyov 14:22) ach besaro alav yichav venafsho alav teeval. vecholla ihu beonsha. ad dinshama itkasharat beduchetaha leella, ucheden kullehu mitkashsherin beduchetayyhu.

Begin dechol hane telat, kishshura chada innun, kegavvna dilella, beraza denefesh ruach uneshama, decholla chad, vekishshura chad. nefesh: let lah nehora miggarmah kelum, veda ihu demishtattefa beraza degufa chad, leanega ulemezan leh, bechol ma deitzterich, kema deat amer (Mishlei 31:15) vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha. beta, da ihu gufa, deihi zana leh. venaaroteha, illen innun shayyfin dehay gufa.

Ruach: da ihu derachiv al hay nefesh, veshalit alah, venahir lah bechol ma deitzterich, venefesh ihu kurseyyay lehay ruach. neshama: ihi deappikat lehay rucha, ushelitat aleh, venahirat leh behahu nehora dechayyin, vehahu ruach talya behay neshama, veitnehir minnah behahu nehora denahir. hahu nefesh, talya behay ruach, veitnehirat minneh, veittezanat minneh, vecholla kishshura chad.

Vead dehay neshama illaa, la salleka go neviu deattika deattikin. setima dechol setimin, veitmalya minneh, begin dela pasik. ruach da la al beginta deeden, deihu nefesh, uleolam ruach la sharya ella beginta deeden, uneshama leella. nefesh da ityashvat (sefer acher lo ateyshebat) beduchetaha go gufa letatta.

Kegavvna da, kolla letatta hachi mitparshan bevar nash, veaf al gav dechullehu kishshura chada, neshama salleka leella, go neviu devera. ruach al beginta deeden, (Vayikra 70 amud bet) kegavvna dilella. nefesh ityashva go kivra. vei tema, nefesh leella, deityashvat go gufa bekivra, an hu kivra. ella go hahu kelifa takkifa, veal da, nefesh kegavvna da letatta, vecholla da kegavvna da. uvegin kach, telat dargin mitparshan, veinnun kishshura chada veraza chada.

Uvechol zimna degarme ishtechachu go kivra, hay nefesh ishtechachat tamman. raza hacha leinun deyade orach keshot, dachale chattaa. beshaata denishmeta mitattera leella, go itra kaddisha, verucha kaim binhiru illaa, beshabbate veyarche uzemane, hay nefesh beshaata deruach nachta miggo nehiru illaa, ledayyayra beginta deeden nahir venatzitz, ihu (davar acher 33 24) kayyayma go kivra veitgelimat bediyyukena, dahavat go gufa bekadmita, vechol innun garme behahu diyyukena salkan, umeshabbechan veodan lekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 35:10) kol atzmotay tomarna Adonai mi chamocha. omrot la ketiv, ella tomarnna.

Veilmale ityehiv reshu leena lemechome vechame belelya deayil (nusach acher denafik) shabbeta, velele yarche uzemane, kediyyukenin al gabbe kivre, odan umeshabbechan lekudesha berich hu. aval tippeshu divne nasha, ka meakkeva lehu, dela yadin, vela mashgichin al ma kayymin behay alma, vela chashshin leashgecha bikara demalka illaa behay alma, kol shekken leashgecha bikara dehahu alma, veal ma kayyeyma, veech mitparshan millin.

Beyoma derosh hashshana, dealma ittedan, vechurseya dedina kayyeyma, legabbe malka illaa, lemedan alma. kol nefesh venefesh meshattan, uvaan rachame al chayye. belelya denafka yoma dedina, azlin veka meshattin lemishma uleminda man hu dina deittedan al alma, ulezimnin deka modiin bechezvav lechayyaya, kema deat amer (Iyov 33:15) bachalom chezyon layla binfol tardema al anashim vegomer, az yigle ozen anashim uvemosaram yachtom. may mosaram. da nefesh, deihi kayyeyma vechatim livne nasha millin, lekabbela musar. (vaychi 221)
Belelya batraa dechagga, deka nafkan pitkin mibbe malka, vehahu tzel adiu mibbene geriu dehay alma, hahu nefesh dekamaran, azla
782: Umeshatteta, (129 amud alef) vechad memana sarcha, beraza gelifa beizka bichtav meforash, yedumiam, defakid bichtav deziva gelifa, uvego chizvavn illain. behahu lelya nachit, vechamma elef alfin veribbo rivvavn immeh, venatlin lehahu tzel mikkol chad vechad, vesallekin, leh leella.

Vehahi nefesh dekamaran, azla umeshatteta vechamat lehahu tzel, vetav leatreh go kivra, veka machrezet lishar metayyay, peloni ate legabban, peloni ate legabban. i zakkaa tava ihu, kullehu chaddan, vei lav, kullehu amre vavy. kad sallekin hahu tzel, sallekin leh legabbe hahu eved meheman, dishmeh metatron, venatil hahu tzel legabbeh, vesalik leh leatrih, kema deat amer, (Iyov 7:2) keeved yishaf tzel, yishaf tzel vadday.

Mehahi shaata veelach, metatkena ducheta lehahi neshama dehahu bar nash, veducheta leruach beginta deeden. veducheta lenefesh lenayycha uleithanaa, beshaata dimshatteta veazla. begin deit (Vayikra 172 amud bet) nefesh delet lah nayycha. veit nefesh deishtetziat im gufa.

Vehay ihi delet lah nayycha, vehay ihi dichtiv bah, (Shmuel 1 25:29) veet nefesh oyvecha yekalenna betoch kaf hakkala. deda ihi azla umeshatteta umitgalgela bechol alma, velet lah nayycha kelal yemama velele, veda ihu onsha yattir mikkolla vehahi detishtetzi im gufa, (hahi dichtiv bah 1 vehichratti otah mikkerev immah ulehay let la davekarenav kelal veit nafsha dela tishtetze im gufah) vetishtetze meatar achara, (sefer acher illaa) hahi dichtiv bah, (Vayikra 22:3) venichreta hannefesh hahi millefanay ani Adonai. man millefanay. dela sharya alah rucha. vechad rucha la sharya alah, let lah shuttafu kelal bema dilella, vela yadat meinnun millin dehahu alma kelal, vehay ihi nefesh kivire.

Nefesh delet (davar acher nefesh deit) lah nayycha, hay ihi kad azla umeshatteta, iarat behay memana yedumiam, uveinnun sarchin dileh, venatlin lah, veaolin lah bechol pitche gan eden, veachzeyayn lah yekara detzaddikayya, vikara dehahu ruach dilah, veihi mitdabbeka beh benayycha, go hahu levusha, ucheden yadat beinnun millin dealma.

Vechad hahu ruach salleka leitattera go neshama illaa leella, hahi nefesh mitkashshera behahu ruach, veitnehirat minneh, kesihara kad itnehirat mishimmesha. veruach mitkashshera go hahi nishmeta. vehahi nishmeta mitkashshera, go sof machashava, deihi raza denfesh dilella.

Vehahi nefesh, itkashsharat go hahu ruach illaa, vehahu ruach itkashshar go hahi neshama illaa. vehahi neshama itkashsharat been sof. ucheden ihu nayycha decholla, vekishshura decholla ella vetatta, kolla beraza chada, vegavvna chada.
