Ucheden da ihu nayycha denefesh diltatta, veal da ketiv, (Shmuel 1 25:29) vehayta nefesh adoni tzerura bitzror hachayyim et Adonai elohecha. begavvna chada, uveraza chada, dehahu et, da kegavvna da.

Kad nachta sihara, raza denefesh illaa, nehora mikkol sitrin. ihi nahara lechol retichin umashshiryayn, veavid lon gufa chada shelema, denahir binhiru beziva illaa. uf hachi kegavvna da, nachta hay nefesh tattaa, nehira mikkol sitrin miggo nehiru denshama, umiggo nehiru deruach, venachta venahara lechol innun retichin umashshiryayn, deinnun shayyfin vegarmin, veavid lon gufa shelema, denahir binhiru.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 58:11) vehisbia betzachtzachot nafshecha, nafshecha mammash, ulevatar veatzmotecha yachalitz, deavid minnayyhu gufa shelema, venahir binhiru, vekam veode umeshabbach lekudesha berich hu, kema deittemar dichtiv, (Tehillim 35:10) kol atzmotay tomarna Adonai mi chamocha. veda ihu nayycha denefesh vadday mikkol sitrin.

Zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, dedachalin lemarehon bealma den, lemizke bitlat neyayche lealma deati. ata rabbi shimon uvarcheh lerabbi abba. amar rabbi shimon, zakkain attun banay, vezakkaa ana deenay chamu bechach. kama
783: Duchetin illain metatkenan lan, unehirin lan, lealma deate.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 125:1) shir hammaalot habbotchim baAdonai kehar tziyyon lo yimmot leolam yeshev, hay kera ukemuha. aval shir hammaalot tushebachta dekamre innun dargin kaddishin illain, missitra digvuran illain, veinnun kegavvna delevae letatta, veinnun maalot, dargin al dargin, ufalchin beraza dechamshin shenin. vehay ihu shir hammaalot habbotchim baAdonai kehar tziyyon da innun tzaddikayyay, deinnun mitrachatzan beh beovadin dilhon.

Kema deat amer (Mishlei 28:1) vetzaddikim kichfir yivtach. vei tema ha tzaddikayyay la mitrachatzan beovadehon kelal, vetadir dachalin, keavraham, dichtiv beh (Bereshit 12:11) vayhi kaasher hikriv lavo mitzrayma vegomer. keyitzchak, dichtiv beh, (Bereshit 26:7) ki yare lemor ishti. keyaakov, dichtiv beh, (Bereshit 32:8) vayyira yaakov meod veyetzer lo. vei hane la itrechitzu beovadehon, kol shekken shear tzaddike alma, veat amarta vetzaddikim kichfir yivtach.

Ella vadday, kichfir ketiv, deha mikkol innun shemahan, la ketiv ella kefir, vela ketiv, la arye, vela shachal, vela shachatz, ella kefir. deihu chalsha uzeira mikkullehu. vela itrechitz becheleh, af al gav deihu takkif. kach tzaddikayyay la itrechitzu beovadehon hasheta, ella kichfir. af al gav deyadin detakif chela deovadehon la itrachatzan ella kichfir, vela yattir.

Uvegine kach habbotchim baAdonai kehar tziyyon vegomer, la kichfir vela kearye, velav kechullehu shemahan. ella kehar tziyyon, veukemuha ma har tziyyon ihu takkif, vela yimmot tadir, uf hachi behahu zimna, lehevo kehar tziyyon. vela kehasheta, dela itrechitzu ella kichfir, dedachil vela itrechitz becheleh. veattun bene kaddishe elyonin, rachtzanuta dilchon kehar tziyyon, vadday zakkain atun bealma den uvealma deate.

Azlu, kad matu lemata, itchashach lelya. amar ribbi shimon, kema deyoma da, anhir lan behay archa, lemizke beh bealma deati, uf hachi hay lelya, yanhir lan, lemizke lan lealma deati, uleaattera millin dimama belelya da kame attik yomin deha keyoma da shelim, la yishtekach bechol darin acharanin. zakkaa chulakana bealma den, uvealma deate.

Alu leveteh derabbi shimon, verabbi elazar verabbi abba verabbi yosi immehon. batto ad deitpelag lelya. kevan deitpelag lelya, amar rabbi shimon lechavrayya, iddan ihu leattera reticha kaddisha leella, beishtaddeluta dilan. amar leh lerabbi yosi, ant dela ishtemau milach behay yoma benana, ant have sheruta, leanhara lelya, deha hasheta iddan reuta ihu, leanhara ella vetatta.

Patach rabbi yosi veamar, shir hashshirim asher lishlomo. shirata da ittear lah shelomo malka, kad itbeni be makdesha, vealmin kullehu ishtelimu, ella vetatta bishlemuta chada. veaf al gav dechavrayyay peliggan behay, (nusach acher matay ittemar) aval shirata da la ittemar, ella bishlimu, kad sihara itmalya bishlimu, uve makdesha itbeni kegavvna dilella beshaata deitbene be makdesha letatta, la hava chedva kameh kudesha berich hu, miyyoma deitbere alma, kehahu yoma.

Mishkan deavad moshe bemadbera, lenachta shechinta leara, behahu yoma mishkan achara ittukam immeh leella, kema deukemuha dichtiv, (Shemot 40:17) hukam hammishkan, hammishkan: mishkan achara (159 amud alef) deitkam immeh, veda mishkan denaar metatron, vela yattir. bayit rishon kad itbene, bayit rishon achara itbene immeh, veitkayyaym bealmin kullehu, veanhir (davar acher bealma veanhir) lechol almin, veitbasam alma, veitpatchu kol mashkofe illain leanhara, vela hava chedva bechol almin kehahu yoma, keden patchu illae vetattae veamru shirata, vehayeynu shir hashshirim. shirata deinnun menaggenin dimnagnan lekudesha berich hu.
784: David malka amar shir hammaalot, shelomo malka amar shir hashshirim, shir meinnun menaggenin. ma ben hay lehay, deha ishtema decholla chad. ella vadday kolla chad, aval beyome dedavid malka, la havo kol innun menaggenin metatkenan beduchetayyhu, lenaggena kedka yeot, uve makdesha la itbene, ubbegin kach la ittakanu leella beduchetayyhu. deha kema deit tikkuni demishmarot beara, uf hachi birkia, vekayymin illen lokovel illen.

Uveyoma deitbeni be makdesha, ittakanu kullehu beduchetayyhu, vesharga dela nahara shariat leanhara. veshirata da ittaknat legabbe malka illaa, malka dishlama dileh. vetushebcha da ihi mealleya, mikkol tushebchan kadmae. yoma deitgele tushebachta da (bealma) beara, hahu yoma ishtechach shelimu becholla, veal da ihu kodesh kodashim.

Besifra deadam kadmaa, hava ketiv beh. beyoma deyitkam be makdesha (davar acher deyitbene bi 445) yittearun avahan shirata, ella vetatta. uvegin kach ashkachna shin meatvavn ravrevan. veillen innun deka attearu, lav deinnun menaggenan, ella deinnun mitare legabbe ela. (davar acher 33 kivyachol) shir deinnun shirin ravrevan, dimmanan al almin kullehu.

Vetaninan, behahu yoma kam yaakov shelema, veal beginta deeden, bechedu, al ducheteh. keden ginta deeden, shaari lenaggena, vechol innun busemin deginta. man garim shirata da, uman amar lah. have ema da yaakov, deilmale ihu la al beginta deeden, la amar ginta shirata.

Shirata da shirata, deihi kelala dechol orayyta. shirata deilae vetattae mitare legabbah. shirata deihi kegavvna dealma dilella, deihu shabbat illaa. shirata dishma kaddisha illaa, itattar begineh. veal da ihu kodesh kodashim. may tama. begin dechol milloy birchimu uvechedva kolla. (veda) begin dechos shel beracha ityehiv bimina, kevan deityehiv bimina, keden kol chedu vechol rechimu ishtechach. uvegin kach birchimu uvechedva kol milloy.

Bezimna dehay yemina ithaddar laachora, kema deat amer (Eicha 2:3) heshiv achor yemino, keden kos shel beracha ityehiv bismala. kevan deityehiv bismala, shariu illae vetattae lemiftach aleh kina. umay kaamre. echa, e ka, e kos shel beracha, daatar illaa dahavet yatva begavveh itmanna veitgera minnah begine kach shir hashshirim, dehava missitra dimina, kol milloy rechimu vechedva. echa, dechasir yemina, veishtechach semala, kol milloy innun kanturin vekinin.

Vei tema, ha kol chidu, vechol chedva, vechol shir, missitra dismala ihu, veal da levae missitra dismala menagne shirata. ella, kol chidu deishtechach missitra dismala, la ishtechach ella bezimna dimina itdabbak bahadeh. uvezimna dimina ittear veitdabbak bahadeh, keden hahu chedva mimina, ihu deka otiv lerittecha, vechad ritcha ishtekach, vechidu ihu missitra dimina, keden chedva shelemata ate mehay sitra.

Vechad yemina la ishtechach, ritcha dismala nafish, vela shachich, vela otiv, vela chadde. keden echa, e ka. kos shel beracha ma tehe aleha, deka yatva bismala, verittecha nafish, vela shachich. vadday kanturin vekinin mitarin.

Aval shir hashshirim, vadday kos shel beracha deityehiv bimina, veitmesar begavveh, veal da kol rechimu vechol chidu ishtechach. uvegin kach kol milloy birchimu uvechedva, vela ishtechach bishar kol shirin dealma hachi. uvegin da missitra daavahan ittear shirata da.

Yoma deitgele shirata da, hahu yoma nachtat shechinta leara, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 8:11) vela yachlu hakkohanim laamod lesharet vegomer. may taama. begin ki male chevod Adonai et bet Adonai. behahu yoma mammash, itgeliat tushebachta
785: Tushebachta deshirata da, ihi kelala dechol orayyta. kelala dechol ovada divreshit, kelala deraza daavahan, kelala degaluta demitzrayim. vechad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim. vetushebachta deyamma. kelala deyod amiran. vekiyyuma dehar sinay. vechad azlu yisrael bemadbera, ad dealu leara, veitbene be makdesha. kelala deitura dishma kaddisha illaa, birchimu uvechedva. kelala degalutehon deyisrael bene amamya, ufurekana dilhon. kelala ditchiyayt hammetim, ad yoma deihi shabbat laAdonai. may dehava, umay dahave, umay dezammin lemeheve, levatar beyoma sheviaa, kad yehe shabbat laAdonai, kolla ihu beshir hashshirim.

Veal da tanenan, kol man deappik pesuka deshir hashshirim, veamar leh beve mishtayya. orayyta ihi chagirat sak, vesalleka legabbe kudesha berich hu, veamra kammeh, avdu li banecha machoch beve mishtayya. vadday orayyta salkat vekaamrat hachi, begin da itzterich lenatra, ulesalleka ittara al resheh devar nash, kol milla umilla deshir hashshirim.

Vei tema amay ihi ben hakketuvim, hachi hu vadday, begin deihu shir tushebachta dichneset yisrael, ka mitattera leella. uvegin kach, kol tushebchan dealma, la salleka reuta legabbe kudesha berich hu, ketushebachta da.

Hachi olifna, shir, chad. hashshirim, teren. asher, ha telat. veraza da, deityehiv kos shel beracha veitnetil ben yemina usemala. vecholla ittear legabbe malka dishlama dileh. uvehay istallak reuta leella leella beraza deen sof. reticha kaddisha hacha ishtechach. deha avahan innun reticha, david malka itchabbar immehon, innun arba raza dirticha kaddisha illaa. uvegin kach, arba tevin behay kera kadmaa, raza dirticha kaddisha shelemata.

Tu raza da, shir: da raza dedavid malka, deihu raza lesalleka beshir. hashshirim: illen avahan, raza dimmanan ravrevan, reticha shelemata kadka yeot. asher lishlomo: raza man derachiv al reticha shelemata da.

Uvehay kera ishtechach shelimu deraza, min (vayyetze 153 amud bet) haolam vead haolam, raza dechol mehemnuta. vecholla ihu reticha shelemata leman diydia, uleman dela ityeda, velet man dekaim leminda beh. veal da ittemar hay kera bed tevin, raza dirticha shelemata mikkol sitrin. mikkan ulehala, raza lechakkimin itmesar.

Vetu it beh raza penimaa, detanenan, man dechame anvin bechelmeh, i chivvarin innun tavin. uchamin, bizmanan tavin, dela bizmanan tzerichin rachame. may shena chivvare, umay shena uchame, umay shena bizmanan, umay shena dela bizmanan. vetu, tanenan achlan leinun uchame, muvetach leh dehu ben alma deate, amay.

Ella tanenan, ilana dechav beh adam kadmaa, anavin havo, dichtiv, (Devarim lak) anavemo inneve rosh. veillen innun anavin uchamin, begin deit anavin uchamin, veit anavin chivvavrin. chivvavrin tavin, deha missetar dechayye innun. uchamin tzerichin rachame, deha missitra demota innun. bizmanan tavin, may taama. begin divzimna dechivvavre shaltan, kolla itbesam, deha behahu zimna kolla itzterich letikkuna, vecholla ihu shappir, vecholla tikkuna chada, uchama vechivvavra. uvizmena dechivvavre la shaltan, veuchame itchazun, leminda deha bedina demota salik, veitzterich rachame, deha ilana dechav beh adam kadmaa, vegarim mota leh ulechol alma chama.

Hacha it leistakkela, vei lav demar hacha, la ema. tanenan dealma da, ihu kegavvna dealma dilella, vealma dilella kol ma dehava behay alma, hachi ihu leella, i nachash garim mota leadam letatta, leella amay.
786: I tema, (od) leitteta, (sefer acher letatta) divgin nachash igra nehora, deha sihara gara nehora lezimnin, uvehahu zimna ihi mitat. dechura amay. dei nima desihara beetyo dehay nachash mitat, bigriu dinhora. ha tanenan, dela begin nachash hava. ella deamra sihara kame kudesha berich hu vechulei, ha la hava begin nachash. vei tema devalah hachi hu, chas veshalom digriu havi leella.

Ella kol da sitre orayyta, venachash becholla atkin geriu. ta chaze vehachi olifna, kol ma deavad kudesha berich hu ella vetatta, kolla beraza didchar venukeba ihu, vechamma dargin innun leella, meshanyayn illen meillen. umidarga ad darga raza deadam, veinnun dargin deinnun zina chada, avad lon kudesha berich hu diyyukena dechad gufa, ad desallekin beraza deadam.

Vetaninan, beyoma tinyayna deovada divreshit, deitbere beh gehinam, itavid chad gufa beraza deadam, veinnun shayyfin memanan demitkarvin leeshsha, umetin umehadderan kemillekaddemin. veda begin deinnun itkerivu legabbe hay chivya, veihu adam kadmaa deitpatta go mashkena behay chivya, veal da mit, vechivya garim leh mota deihu kariv leh.

Uvechol atar adam dechar venukeba ihu, aval (491 247 amud bet) adam deihu kaddisha illaa, ihu shalta al kolla, da yahiv mezona vechayyin lecholla. veim kol da becholla mana nehora hay chivya takkifa. kad masiv mishkena nukeba dehahu adam kidkaamar mitat, udechura mit, vesallekin kemillekaddemin. veal da kolla kegavvna dilella.

Achal innun anavin uchamin, muvetach leh dehu ben alma deate, begin deshetze, veshalit al hahu atar, (nusach acher veabar) veitgabbar aleh, veadak leh, kema deat amer (Daniel 7) achla umaddeka. kevan deabar hahi kelifa takkifa, ha itkerav legabbe alma deate, velet man demache bideh. veal da, man dechame bechelmeh deinnun anavin uchamin achil umehadek muvetach leh vechulei.

Kegavvna da, la have shir beveta dedavid, ad deitabbaru innun anavin uchamin, veshalta alayyhu, ucheden ittemar shir hashshirim, kema deittemar. vaafillu beatar da ikre anavim, kema deat amer (Hoshea 9:10) kaanavim bammidbar vegomer, veillen innun anavim chivvavrin.

Shirata da ihi mealleya al kol shear shirin dekadmae. kol shirin dekadmae amru, la seliku ella go shirin demalache illae amre. veaf al gav deha ukemuha, aval ketiv shir hammaalot ledavid, shir hammaalot shir demalache illae amre. deinnun maalot vedargin. amre leman. ledavid. levaksha tarpa umezona minneh.

Tu shir hammaalot, kema deat amer (Tehillim 46:1) al alamot shir. (Shir HaShirim 1:3) al ken alamot ahevucha. ledavid, begin david malka illaa, deihu (vaychi 251 amud alef) meshabbach tadir lemalka illaa.

Kevan deata shelomo malka, amar shir deihu illaa leella. deravreve alma illain, kaamre legabbe malka illaa, dishlama kolla dileh. kullehu deamre shirata, la seliku behahi shirata lomar, ella hahu shirata demalache illae kaamre. bar shelomo malka, desalik behahi shirata lemma deravrevin illain ammude alma kaamre. kol bene alma birtichin tattain, shelomo malka birtichin illain.

Vei tema, moshe desalik bedarga dinvua uvachavivu legabbe kudesha berich hu, al kol bene alma, hahi shirata dekaamar birtichin tattain hava, vela salik yattir. ta chazi, shirata dekaamar moshe, salik leella vela letatta. aval la amar shirata kishlomo malka, vela hava bar nash desalik beshirata kishlomo.

Moshe salik betushebachteh leella, vetushebachta dileh hava, lemehav tushebchan vehodaan lemalka illaa, desheziv lon leyisrael, veavid lon nissin ugevuran bemitzrayim, veal yamma. aval david malka, ushelomo bereh, amru shirata
787: Begavvna achara. david ishtaddal leatkena ulemtan, ulekashta lon bematronita, leitchazaa matronita veulemtaha bishfiru, veal da ishtaddal beinnun shirin vetushebchan degaveyhu, ad deatkin vekashit kullehu ulemtan umatronita.

Kevan deata shelomo, ashkach lematronita mitkashsheta, veulemtaha bishfiru, ishtaddal lemeal lah legabbe chatan, veail hechatan lachuppa bematronita, veail millin dirchimu benayyhu, begin lechabbera lon kachada, ulemehve tarvavyyhu bishlimu chada bechavivu shelim. veal da shelomo salik betushebachta illaa, al kol bene alma.

Moshe, zivvevg lematronita behay alma letatta, lemehve behay alma beziuuga shelim betattae. shelomo, zivvevg lah lematronita beziuuga shelema leella, veail hechatan lachuppa bekadmita, ulevatar al letarvavyyeyhu behay alma, vezammin lon bechedva beve makdesha deihu bana.

Vei tema, hech ayiyil moshe lematronita bilchodaha behay alma, deha itchaze piruda. ta chaze, kudesha berich hu zivvevg lah bemoshe bekadmita, veihu havavt kallat moshe, kema deittemar. kevan deizdavvevgat beh bemoshe, nachtat behay alma. beziuuga dehay alma, veittakkanat behay alma, ma dela havavt mikkadmat dena, uleolam la havavt beferuda.

Aval la hava bar nash bealma miyyoma deitbere adam, deyeil rechimu vechavivu, umillin deziuuga leella, bar shelomo malka, deihu atkin ziuuga dilella bekadmita, ulevatar zamin lon kachada beveta deatkin lon. zakkain innun david ushelomo bereh, deinnun atkinu ziuuga dilella. miyyoma deamar lah kudesha berich hu lesihara, zili veaziri garmich, la izdavvevgat beziuuga shelim beshimsha, bar kad ata shelomo malka.

Shir hashshirim, ha hacha chamesh dargin, leitdabbeka bealma deate. shir, chad. hashshirim, teren, ha telat. asher, ha arbea. lishlomo, ha chamsha. bechamishaa ihu. deha yoma dechamshin, raza deyovla ihu.

Ta chaze, ziuuga dilella la yachil shelomo leatkena, ella begin deishtechach ziuuga letatta, mikkadmat dena. uman ihu. ziuuga demoshe. dei la have ziuuga dena, la ittakkan ziuuga dilella. vecholla beraza illaa ihu, lechakkime libba.

Ketiv (Melachim 1 Adonai:12) vaydabber sheloshet alafim mashal vayhi shiro chamishsha vaalef, hay kera ukemuha chavrayyay. aval vaydabber sheloshet alafim mashal, vadday al kol milla umilla deihu hava amar, havo beh telat elef meshale, kegon sifra dekohelet, deihu beraza illaa, veihu beorach mashal, delet beh kera delav ihu bechachmeta illaa, uveorach mashal, afillu kera zeira deveh.

Dechad hava mate rav hamenuna sava kadmaa lehay kera, (Kohelet 11:9) semach bachur beyaldutecha vitivcha libbecha bime vechurotecha hava bachi. veamar vadday hay kera yeot hu, veihu beorach mashal, uman yachil lemebad derasha bemashal da. vei ihu derasha let beh derasha, ella kema dachamenan beayynin. vei chachmeta ihu, man yachil leminda lah.

Miyyad hava tav veamar, ketiv, (Bereshit 37:2) elle toldot yaakov yosef ben sheva esre shana vegomer, hay kera dekohelet, ihu mashal lechachmeta dikra da deorayyta, veda mashal leda. semach bachur beyaldutecha, vehu naar. vitivcha libbecha, haya roe et echav batztzon. bime vechurotecha, et bene vilha veet bene zilpa neshe aviv. veda ki al kol elle, vayyave yosef et dibbatam raa. yeviacha elohim bammishpat, elle toldot yaakov yosef. yosef itkelil beyaakov, verazin desitre tora, man yachil leminda lon.
Vehay mashal itpashat litlat elef meshalim, vechullehu
788: Behay mashal, beshaata deyosef itkelil beyaakov, telat elef innun, beavraham yitzchak veyaakov, dechullehu behay mashal beraza dechachmeta. vechan, kama tayayin innun betoanin ditmiru, behu dayyayre terisin, delet lehon chushebana litmirin dechachmeta.

Vayhi shiro chamishsha vaalef, hachi okimna, vayhi shiro shel mashal, vecholla chad, ben man deamar vayhi shiro dishlomo, ben man deamar vayhi shiro shel mashal, kolla ihu chad, vecholla ihu kaamar, vayhi shiro, da shir hashshirim. vechi chamishsha vaelef ihu shir hashshirim. vadday hachi hu, chamishsha innun tarin ufatchin demitpatteche bemalka dishlama dileh. veinnun chamesh mea shenin deilana dechayye. chamshin shenin deyovla.

Vaalef, da ihu ilana dechayye, chatan denafik missitreh, veihu yarit kol innun chamishsha, lemete legabbe kalla. yomeh dekudesha berich hu elef shenin ihu, veda ihu nahar denagid venafik meeden. yosef zakkaa. deikre tzaddik, al shema desihara. kema deatni bah kudesha berich hu. uvegin kach shir hashshirim, kodesh kodashim.

Velet lecha kera beshir hashshirim, dela it beh raza dechamishsha vaelef vadday. shir hashshirim vadday hachi hu. chamesh dargin innun behay kera, kema deittemar. vei tema, haelef amay la idkar hacha. vadday hahu elef temira hava, utemira ihu ad deitchabbarat itteta bevalah. veal da ishtaddal shelomo, lemete hahu elef legabbe kalla, bitmiru degushepanka dechachmeta illaa.

Kevan deavad kodesh hakkodashim letatta, ganiz vetamir, veal raza dekodesh hakkodashim letamman, lemebad genizu deshimmusha shelim, ella vetatta kedka yeot. kodesh (121 amud alef) hakkadashim ihu leella, raza dechachmeta illaa, veyovla. kegavvna da yartin chatan vechalla, yaruta deabba veima.

Veithadderu achasanat yeruta begavvna achara. yeruta deabba, yarta beratta, bisliku dishma kaddisha da, veitkere uf hachi kodesh, chachma. yaruta deima, yarit bera, veikre kodashim, begin denatil kol innun kodashim illain, vechanish lon legabbeh. uvatar yahiv lon, veail lon legabbe kalla.
Veal da amar shir hashshirim. shir, legabbe kodesh. hashshirim, legabbe kodashim, lemehve kolla kodesh kodashim, beraza chada kema deitchaze. asher lishlomo ha ittemar lemalka dishlama dileh.

Vei tema shevacha da dileh hu. la tema hachi, ella shevacha baatar illaa ihu salleka. aval hacha hu raza. kad metatkenan dechar venukeba kachada, techot malka illaa, keden hahu malka istalik leella, veitmalya mikkol kidushin, umikkol birkan, denagdin letatta, veitmele vearik letatta, veda ihu tiuveteh demalka illaa, kad itmele kiddushan uvirkan, vearik letatta.

Veal da ihu tzelotin uvautin, deyittakkan veitmalya hahu mabbua illaa. dechevan deihu mittakkan kadka yeot, mechezu dileh, umechezu dehahu tikkuna, mittakna alma tattaa, veulemtaha. vela itzterich alma tattaa leittakna, ella mechezu dealma illaa. sihara, let lah chezu migarmaha kelal, bar kad ittakkan beshimsha veanhir, umechezu deshimsha vetikkuna dileh ittaknat sihara veitnehirat.

Ma deitzterich tzelotin uvautin, deyitnehir veyittakan hahu atar denafka minneh nehora, dechevan dehahu atar mittakna, mechezu dileh, ittakkan kol man diltatta. uvegin kach tushebachta dekaamar shelomo, la ishtaddal ella begin malka dishlama dileh, deyittakkan. kevan deihu ittakkan, mechezu dileh, kolla yittakkan. vei ihu la ittakkan, let lah tikkuna lesihara lealmin, uvegin kach asher lishlomo. deyittakkan veyitmale kadka yeot bekadmita, kema deittemar.
789: (Shemot 25:2) veyikchu li teruma meet kol ish vegomer, raza derazin leyade chachmeta, kad istallak biruta desitra dechol sitrin lemebad yekara likareh, anshiv rucha minkuda illaa, denagid milleella letatta, veshavve tekkuneh, leityashsheva behay alma. amay. begin dei la yehe ikkara vesharsha behay alma, la yehe mana learka behay alma kelal. vei la yarik lehay alma, miyyad itavid, vela yachil lekayyeyma afillu riga chada. aval begin detikuneh ihu mehay alma itmele missitra chada learka lehay alma, umissitra achara learka lemalache illae. vecholla ittezanu minneh kachada.

Shelimu detikkuna dehay rucha, ruchehon detzaddikayya behay alma. rucha da ishtelim, bezimna dachanoch veyyered umahalalel havo bealma vechad asgiu chayyayve alma, adu hahu shelimu minneh. levatar deitavidu, ata noach veashlim leh. ata dor happelaga, adu hahu shelimu minneh. ata avraham veashlim leh. atu anshe sedom veaadu leh. ata yitzchak veashlim leh. atu pelishtim vechayyayve dara veaadu leh minneh. ata yaakov uvenoy, arsa shelema, veashlimu leh.

Nafku meara kaddisha venachtu lemitzrayim, uveginayyhu itakkavat tamman. uvegin deahadri tamman yisrael leovadin demitzrae, itkafya veitade hahu shelimu, ad denafku mimmitzrayim, veatu lemebad mashkena. amar kudesha berich hu, reuti ledayyeyra benayychu, aval la yachilna ad dittaknun hahu rucha dili, deyishre begavavyychu. hada hu dichtiv, veasu li mikdash veshachanti betocham.

Veda ihu raza dichtiv, veyikchu li teruma. amar moshe lekudesha berich hu man yachil lemesav lah ulemebad lah. amar leh, moshe, la kema deat chashiv, ella meet kol ish asher yiddevennu libbo vegomer, mehahu reuta verucha dilhon, tisbun lah, vetashlimun lah.

Kad ata shelomo, atkin lehahu rucha bishlimu dilella, deha min yoma deishtelim letatta beyomoy demoshe, la adiu hahu shelimu minneh. (74 deata shelomo) kevan deata shelomo, ishtaddal leashlema leh leella, veshaari leatkena chezu dealma illaa, leittakna mehahu chezu alma tattaa, veda ihu asher lishlomo.

(Shemot 25:3) vezot hatteruma, ha ittemar, dechad kudesha berich hu itgele al tura desinay, kad ityehivat orayyta leyisrael beeser amiran. kol amira vaamira avid kalla, vehahu kalla itperash le kalin, vahavu kullehu nehirin venatztzin leenayyhu deyisrael kullehu, vahavu chaman ayynin beayynin ziv yekara dileh, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 20:15) vechol haam roim et hakkolot. roim vadday.

Vehahu kalla hava atre beh bechol chad vechad miyyisrael, veamar lon, tekabbeleni alach, bechach vechach pikkudin divorayyta, veamru hin. ahdar leh al resheh, umitgalgela aleh, vahava atre beh, veamar leh, tekabbeleni alach bechach onashin divorayyta, vahava amar hin. levatar ahdar hahu kalla, venashik leh befumeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 1:2) yishshakeni minneshikot pihu.

Ucheden kol ma dahavo chaman yisrael behahu zimna, havo chaman go chad nehora, dekabbil kol innun nehorin acharanin, vahavu taavin lemechome. amar lon kudesha berich hu, hahu nehora dechamitu betura desinay, dekabbil kol innun gevavne nehorin, vetiuveta dilchon aleh, tekabbelun lah vetisvun lah legabbayychu, veinnun gavvnin deihi mekabbela, illen innun zahav vachesef unechoshet vegomer.

Davar acher yishshakeni minneshikot pihu, may ka chama shelomo malka, deihu ail mille dirchimu ben alma illaa lealma tattaa, vesheruta detushebachta dirchimu deail benayyhu, yishshakeni ihu. ella ha ukemuha (124 amud bet) vehachi ihu, delet rechimu didvekut derucha
790: Berucha, bar (256 amud bet) neshika. uneshika befuma, deihi mabbua derucha, umafkanu dileh. vechad nashkin da leda, mitdabbekan ruchin illen beillen, vahavu chad, ucheden ihu rechimu chad.

Besifra derav hamenuna sava kadmaa, hava amar al hay kera, neshika dirchimu itpashat led ruchin, ved ruchin mitdabbekan kachada, veinnun go raza dimhemnuta vesallekin bed atvavn, veinnun atvavn dishma kaddisha tale behu, veillain vetattain talyayn behu. vetushebachta deshir hashshirim tale behu. uman ihu. ahava. veinnun reticha illaa. veinnun chavruta udevekuta ushelimu decholla.

Illen atvavn. 4 ruchin innun. veinnun ruchin dirchimu vechedva dechol shayyfe gufa bela atzivu kelal. 4 ruchin innun binshika, kol chad vechad kalil bechavreh. vechad hay rucha kalil beachara, vehahu achara kalil behay. itavidu teren ruchin kachada. ucheden mitchabberan bidbiku chad, innun arba bishlimu, venavin da beda, veitkelilu da beda.

Vechad mitpashshetan, (nusach acher mitparshan) itavid meinnun arba ruchin chad ibba, veihu rucha chada dechalil med ruchin. veda salik uvaka rekiin, ad (223 amud bet) desalik veyativ legabbe chad hechala. deitkere hechala deahava, veihu hechala dechol rechimu talya beh. vehahi rucha hachi ikre ahava, vechad hay rucha salik ittear lehahu hechala, leitchabbera leella.

4 ' Atvavn innun, legabbe 4 ruchin. veinnun ahava. veibba dilhon ahava. kad mitchabberan da beda, miyyad ittear da bistar da veda bistar da. 1. miyyad nafik Adonai, veitchabbar be, mitdavak bidviku birchimu. veitavidu (nusach acher veattearu) teren atvavn acharanin, 2 Adonai, veitkelilu ruchin beruchin bidbiku dirchimu, ufarchin illen atvavn minnayyhu, behahu rucha desalik, umitatteran beh kedka yeot.

Kevan deazil vesalik hahu ahava shelema, kelila bechol innun arba ruchin, paga bechad memana illaa ravreva, di memana al elef utesha mea vetishin rekiin, veihu memana al negidu ditlesar nahare afarsemona dachya, denagda meraza detala dilella. vehahu negidu itkere mayim rabbim. kevan defaga legabbe hahu rav mashreyayn kaim legabbeh, vela yachil leakava leh, veaovar behu ad deail legabbe hechol ahava.

Al da amar shelomo, besium shevacheh, (Shir HaShirim 8:7) mayim rabbim lo yuchelu lechabbot et haahava. mayim rabbim: illen mayim illain denagdin go (sefer acher miggo) talla illaa. uneharot la yishtefuha: illen innun nahare afarsemona dachya, deinnun telesar. hahu memana ihu malacha deshaliach min kodam Adonai, veda ihu rav mashshiryayn dekashir kitrin lemareh, raza achtariel, meatter itrin lemareh, bishma gelifa mechukkaka, Adonai yah tzevaot.

Kevan deail legabbe hechol (nusach acher deazil vesalik hahu) ahava, itar rechimu denshikin illain, dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:11) vayyishshak yaakov lerachel, lemeheve neshikin dirchimu illaa kedka yeot, veinnun neshikin sheruta deitaru dechol rechimu, veitdabbekuta vekishshura dilella. ubbegin kach sheruta detushebachta deshirata da ihu yishshakeni.

Man yishshakeni. hahu desatim go setimu illaa. vei tema, setima dechol setimin beh talyayn neshikin venashik letatta. ta chaze, setima dechol setimin, let man deyada leh, veihu galle minneh nehiru chad dakik satim, dela itgele bar bechad shevil dakik deitpashshat miggaveh, veihu nehiru denahir lecholla. veda ittearu dechol razin illain. veihu satim. lezimnin satim, lezimnin itgalya. veaf al gav dela itgalya kelal. veittearu disliku denshikin beh talyayn. umiggo deihu satim, sheruta detushebachta beorach satim ihu.
Vei beh talyayn ma bae yaakov hacha, deha beh talyayn neshikin. ella vadday hachi hu. yishshakeni, hahu desatim leella. uvemma.
791: Behahu reticha (nusach acher butzina) illaa, dechol gavvnin talyayn umitchabberan beh. vehay ihu yaakov. kema deamrinan, devekuta leitdabbeka bemalka bivra dileh hu. veal da ketiv (Shir HaShirim 1:2) minneshikot pihu.

Ki tovim dodecha, ahdar legabbe shimsha, deanhir lah lesihara, miggo nehiru deinnun butzinin illain, veihu natil nehora dechullehu, veanhir lesihara. veinnun butzinin (nusach acher neshikin) illain, veihu natil nehora dechullehu, veanhir lesihara veinnun butzinin demizdavvevgin beh, mean atar naharin. hadar veamar miyyayin, mehahu yayin demintera, mehahu yayin deihu chedva dechol chedvavn. uman ihu hahu yayin, deyahiv chayyin vechedva lecholla. da elohim chayyim, yayin, deyahiv chayyin vechedva lecholla.

Tu miyyayin, mehahu shema deikre Adonai, da ihu yayin dechedva dirchimu derachame, umin da, kullehu nehirin vechaddan. atu chavrayyay venashiku leh beresheh. (24 matu legabbe derabbi shimon siddero milin kammeh)

Bacha rabbi shimon, veamar, yadana vadday derucha kaddisha illaa ka mechashkesha (davar acher manetzatzea) bechu, zakkaa dara da, deha la yehe kedara da, ad zimna deyete malka meshicha. deha orayyta ithadderat leattikutaha. zakkain innun tzaddikayya bealma den uvealma deate.

(Shemot 25:3) vezot hatteruma asher tikchu meittam. rabbi elazar amar, hay kera ukemuha, verazin dileh ha ittemar. aval (pashta) raza dikra hachi olifna, vekashyayn kerae, dei innun beraza diltatta kashyayn ahadde. vei beraza dilella la innun binhiru. (ella hachi hu) dabber el bene yisrael veyikchu li teruma shappir. tikchu et terumati kashya. vezot hatteruma asher tikchu meittam kashya veda (sefer acher vadday) kolla, ella vetatta kachada.

Ella hachi ihu, veyikchu li teruma. man. bene yisrael. meet kol ish: illen malachin illain leella, begin dealehon ihi teruma, aramuta deinnun arimu lah tadir legabbe malka illaa deha innun sallekin lah tadir, legabbe malka illaa. vechad yisrael zakkain, innun natlin lah minnayyhu, venachtin lah letatta, hada hu dichtiv, meet kol ish asher yiddevennu libbo. uman innun. innun arba dearimu lah leella. dehahu lev itree behu. vehahi teruma. ihi zakfa alayyhu.

Veaf al gav deihi kayyayma alayyhu, umancha al gabbayyhu. tikchu: tisvun lah minnayyhu lenachtaha letatta. uvema. bezimna da, beinnun ovadin dechashran, bitzlotin uvevautin, lemebad pikkude orayyta. behahu zimna, beinnun gavvnin deitchazyayn letatta kegavvna dilella, beinnun pulechanin (acharanin.) veinnun gavvnin amshechan letatta hahu aramuta, venatzchan gavvnin diltatta, leinun gavvnin dilella, umashchin lon gavvnin illen, ligvavnin illain, veayylin illen beillen, veitavidu illen gufa leillen, veal da tikchu meittam ketiv.

Zahav deitkelil begavriel, zahav leella, gavriel natil leh letatta. veshiva zine zahav itparshan letatta min da. vachesef leella, veitkelil bemichael letatta, vesharya da al da. unechoshet leella, venafka min zahav, begin dezahav veeshsha beraza chada kayymin veazlin, eshsha appik nechoshet. umechela vetukpa da, itbadran (nusach acher itarun) nechashim serafim denafke meeshsha. veal da, nechoshet ihu sumaka keeshsha veitkelil beuriel (nusach acher 297) veitavid da gufa legabbe da.

Utechelet sharya beda uveda, bannechoshet uvazzahav, uvegin deittakkaf bitren sitrin. techelet ihu takkifa, velet man deshalta (152 amud alef) aleh lechayin, deihu kurseyyay dedina lesharya beh dina takkifa, veda ihu 8 31 8 31 dichtiv, (tehillim 7) veel zoem bechol yom. vechad ithadran beni nasha betiuveta shelemata, (260 amud bet, 210 amud alef) ithaddar shemeh refael, deha asvavta izdaman lehu mehahu dina
792: Veargaman: da zahav vachesef, deithadran leachlela kachada, michael vegavriel itkelilu da im da, meshullevan da beda. veal da ketiv, (Iyov 25:2) ose shalom bimromav. uvegin deinnun meshullevan da beda, itavidu gufa chad.
Vetolaat shani leella, veitkelil beuriel kemillekaddemin, lemehve achidu go techelet, uvego argaman. veshesh ihu leella, veitkelil kemillekaddemin beraza dirfael, leitachada bakkesef uvazzahav.
Ad hacha, raza dez ammudin leella, go 7 ammudim diltatta. kelippa go kelippa, lintura. veizzim: ha okimna deha illen 7, mocha lemocha, veda ihu kelippa lemocha.

(Shemot 25:5) veorot elim meaddamim, illen innun mare terisin, ayynin melahatin betisin denura, kema deat amer, (Daniel 10:6) veenav kelappide esh. veikrun rekiin levar bego kelifa. (Shemot 25:5) veorot techashim, illen innun lego besitra kaddisha, veitachadan bikdusha, vela itachadan.

Kema (139 amud alef) deamaran deavraham ha olid beintu achara tachash kema deat amer (139 1) veet tachash veillen innun beima deyishmael achuhon deyishmael dekma deit darga beesav hachi name it darga beyishmael. ima deyishmael olidot letachash umissitra deavraham kaattat deha nehora kadmaa (Vayikra 292 2) 300 beshaata denafak nehorin lechol sitrin. kevan deitbesam hahu nehora kadmaa ganiz leh kudesha berich hu uleman ganiz leh (sham 91 2) letzaddikayyay. uman innun. tzaddik vetzedek begin lemebad behahu nehora kadmaa ibbin lealma. veinnun ibbin dizminin lemete lealma. deha avraham vesara avdu (sefer acher veavraham vesara mehahu nehora avdo) ibbin venafshin dichtiv (Bereshit 12:5) veet hannefesh asher asu becharan. ukkema deavdu nafshan besitra dikdusha hachi (338 168 1) name avad nefesh besitra achara deilmale hahu itaru deitar avraham besitra achara la ishtechachu giurin bealma kelal. (Shemot 25:5) vaatze shittim, ha okimna deinnun serafim omdim, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 6:2) serafim omdim mimmaal lo. may mimmaal lo. mimmaal lehahi kelifa. vei tema, hay kera bekudesha berich hu ittemar, veha ittemar (yeshaya 6) vaere et Adonai, et dayyka, kegavvna da dichtiv behay kera, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 6:1) veshulav meleim et hahechol, et dayyka leassegaa hahi kelippa. kevan deamar raza dehahi kelippa, ketiv serafim omdim mimmaal lo, mimmaal lehahi kelippa.

(Shemot 25:6) shemen lammaor, da meshach revut illaa, deatya milleella. teren shemen innun. veinnun tere, (davar acher chad) leella, deikre shemen hammaor. vechad letatta deikre shemen lammaor. shemen hammaor ihu illaa, dekayyeyma bevadday, vela pasik lealmin, vetadir malya revut kudsha, vechol birkan, vechol nehorin, vechol butzinin, kolla itbarchan veitnaharan mittamman. shemen lammaor, lezimnin itmalya ulezimnin la.

Tu, ha tanenan, ketiv (Bereshit 1:16) vayyaas elohim et sheni hammeorot haggedolim vegomer, veaf al gav deha ukemuha chavrayyay, vehachi ihu. aval shene hammeorot haggedolim illen: shemen hammaor, veshemen lammaor. alma illaa, vealma tattaa. chad dechar, vechad nukeba. vechol zimna didchura venukeba atyayn kachada, (Bereshit 49 amud alef) tarvavyyhu karyayn belishna didchura. uvegin dealma illaa ikre gadol, begineh alma tattaa deitchabbar bahadeh bichlala, ikre gadol.

Kevan deitperash da min da, idkaru bifrat, kol chad vechad kadka chazi leh. da ikre gadol, veda ikre katan. ubbegin kach amru kadmae, deliheve bar nash zanva learyavavta, vela resha leshualaya. dechad ihu kayyma go aryevavta, ikre kolla bichlala dearyavavta. zanva dearya arya ihu, bela piruda. vei bego shualim, afillu ihu
793: Resha. resha deshual shual ihu, bela piruda, veshual ikre.

Veraza da hay kera, deha bekadmita kad yatvin kachada, shene hammeorot haggedolim itkerun, af al gav deda zanva legabbe deillaa. kevan deda itperash meillaa, kivyachol lemehve resha leshualim, keden ikre katan. veal raza da shemen hammaor, dela pasik lealmin, vekayyeyma bisliku illaa lemishlat bimama. shemen lammaor pasik, veikre katan, veshalta belelya.
Vechamesh busemin innun lego shemen uketoret, veaf al gav deihi chad innun terin vecholla chad. (Shemot 25:7) avne soham vegomer. kol hane telesar innun veinnun tikkuna demashkena.

Veahadarna lemille kadmae, zahav ha ittemar deshiva zini zahav innun. vei tema dezahav ihu dina, vechesef ihu rachame, veistallak zahav leella minneh. lav hachi, devadday zahav salik yattir ihu al kolla, aval zahav beorach setam ihu, veda zahav illaa, deihu sheviaa mikkol innun zini zahav, veda ihu zahav denahir venatzitz leayynin, veda ihu dechad nafik lealma, (davar acher 33 nafik) man deidbak leh, tamir leh begavveh, umittamman nafke veitmashshechan kol zini zahav.

Ematay ikre zahav, man deikre zahav. kad ihu binhiru, veistallak bikar dechilu, veihu bechedva illaa, lemechode letattae. vechad ihu bedina, kad ishtane mehahu gon, legavevn tichla ucham vesumak, keden ihu bedina takkifa. aval zahav, bechedva ihu, uvisliku didchilu dechedva kayyeyma, uveitaruta dechedva.

Vachesef letatta, raza deroa yemina, deha resha illaa zahav ihu, dichtiv, (Daniel 2) ant hu resha dedahava. (Daniel 2:32) chadohi uderaohi di chesaf letatta. (nusach acher veematay ayshatelaym kesef kad itkelil vechulei) vechad ishtelim kesef, keden itkelil bazzahav, veraza da (Mishlei 25:11) tappuche zahav bemmaschiyyot kasef. ishtechach dechesef ithaddar lezahav, ucheden ishtelim atreh. (nusach acher elim arye) veal da 7 zine zahav innun.

Unechoshet nafka mizzahav, veishtane legirona, deroa semala. utechelet yarcha semala. vetolaat shani, yarcha yemina, veitkelil bismala. veshesh, da nahar denagid venafik, deihu natil kol shit sitrin. kegavvna da letatta, veha ukemuha veittemar.

Ha hacha sheva deyovel, veinnun 7 dishmitta. veaf al gav deinnun shit, innun telesar, bishviaa, deihu resha alayyhu, ha telesar. risha dekayyeyma al kol gufa letatta, resha dekayyeyma al kol shayyfe gufa, ihu zahav. ma ben hay lehay. zahav illaa, ihu beraza setima, ushema dileh ihu zahav sagur. sagur vesatum mikkolla, veal ken ikre sagur, deihu sagur meena dela shalta beh. zahav tattaa ihu beitgalleya yattir. (veshemma dileh aykari zahav yerakrak vechulei.)

Leshaata hava, dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 2 24:20) veruach elohim lavsha et zecharya. veim tomar, ha yirmeyahu, dichtiv beh, (Yirmeyahu 1:Adonai) beterem etzarcha vabbeten yedaticha. veha acharanin. ella kullehu la zachu linvua velichhuna illaa keaharon, deha aharon zacha binnevua illaa, al kol shear kahani. zacha bichhuna al kullehu.

Moshe zacha binnevua, veshimmesh bichhuna illaa. shemuel zacha betarvavyyhu. ma moshe hava kare, vekudesha berich hu ativ leh miyyad. uf shemuel ketiv beh, (Shmuel 1 12:17) halo ketzir chittim hayyom ekra el Adonai veyitten kolot vegomer. aval la salik ledarga illaa kemoshe. ma aharon hava meshammesh bichhuna gabbe kudesha berich hu, uf shemuel hava meshammesh kame kudesha berich hu, aval la salik beshimusha illaa keaharon.

Umilla hachi hu. telata innun dahavo nevie mehemne, veshimmeshu bichhuna. chad moshe, vechad aharon, vechad shemuel. vei tema shemuel lo mashich (sefer acher shemesh) bichhuna, ella achara hava deshimmesh bichhuna, umannu
794: Yirmeyahu. lav hachi, deha ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 1:1) min hakkohanim asher (vaychi 249 amud bet) baanatot. min hakkohanim hava, aval la shimmesh. ushemuel beyome deeli shimmesh. umoshe zimna chada, kol innun 7 yeme milluim.

Shemuel zacha lenaar, dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 1:24) vehanaar naar. (Shmuel 1 2:18) ushemuel mesharet. uvegin dekayyeyma behay darga, vadday ihu kemoshe veaharon. man denatil lehay naar, vezache beh, zache beinnun dargin illain, dekayymin behu moshe veaharon.

Keruvim innun zahav, kema deukemuha, begin denafke missitra dezahav, vela itarav behu kesef, vela gon achara, veda ihu gon zahav yerakrak. bamishkan mitarvin gevavnin, zahav vachesef lemehach kachada, lemeheve raza dilella bechad. tu nechoshet lemehve bahadayyhu, ulemezal benayyhu kol sitrin, leishtachcha shelimu becholla kachada, dichtiv zahav vachesef unechoshet.

Davar acher zahav vachesef. zahav deithadar lechesef, vechesef lezahav, vecholla itkelil kachada, uveducheta chada. bitlat gavvnin ithaddar, kad itzterich lecheddevavta vela dina, zahav. kad itzterich lerachame, chesef. kad itzterich tukpa dedina, nechoshet.

Veal da istakkal moshe, beovada dinchash hannechoshet, dichtiv (Bamidbar 21:9) vayyaas moshe nechash nechoshet, vahava yada atar dehitucha dezahav behahu nechoshet, begin denachash kelishana dileh hu, veatreh hava yada. deha kudesha berich hu la amar leh ella ase lecha saraf, veihu ata vaavad nechash nechoshet, dechtiv vayyaas moshe nechash nechoshet. may taama.

Ella atar hava yada, veikara demilta hava, deha bekadmita ketiv, (Bamidbar 21:6) vayshallach Adonai baam et hannechashim hassorafim, uchetiv (Devarim 8:15) nachash saraf. ikkara dilhon nachash ihu. uvegin demoshe hava yada ikkara vesharasha visoda mehahu atar, avad nachash veistemich aleh. may tama. begin deyisrael chatu belishanehon, dechtiv (Bamidbar 21:5) vaydabber haam belohim uvemoshe, veal da vayshallach Adonai baam et hannechashim hasserafim.

Umoshe la azal ella batar ikkara, vaavad nechash nechoshet, behahu gavvna deitzterich leh, deha atreh nechoshet ihu. vekudesha berich hu la amar leh mimma yitavid, umoshe istakkal vaavad leh minchoshet, kema deitzterich leatreh. menalan. dichtiv vayyaas moshe nechash nechoshet vaysimehu al hannes. may al hannes. al hahu reshimu deihu leella.

Veha tanenan, bechol atar hay nachash azla batar raza deeshet chayil, uvaya eshet zenunim leittakna garmah kegavvna dilah, vela yachilat. eshet chayil, hahu reshimu veat dilah, ihu at Adonai, vehachi itchaze lah. eshet zenunim hahu reshima veat dilah ihu kehahu gavvna (nusach acher 334) vela ittakkan lemeheve hachi, veat dilah 100, (152 amud alef) at dilah ittakna betikkuna deat Adonai, (sefer acher et 100 behahu gavvna 9 velo ittakna lemeheve hachi et dilah ittakna betikkuna deat Adonai) kegavvna dekofa etzel bene nasha, deazla batar bene nasha, vela ittakkan lemebad hachi. kegavvna da avad moshe hahu nachash, al hahu reshimu deitchaze leh, vetadir ittakkan leavasha, vealeh chav adam, veittarach migginta deeden, dehava atar dioreh kegavvna dediura dilella. (amro hamegayhaym beharebe haatakevat nametzaavat ketuvot kan hishshava hechalot veshiva medurot uchevar nadepasev befarashat Bereshit daf 38 ki sham betam)

Ketiv (Bereshit 1:3) vayyomer elohim yehi or vayhi or. amar rabbi yosi, hahu or itgeniz veihu izdaman legabbe tzadikayya lealma deate. kema deukemuha, dichtiv, (Tehillim 97:11) or zarua latztzadik. latztzadik vaday setam. vehahu or la shimesh bealma, bar yoma kadmaa. ulevatar itgeniz, vela shimmesh yatir.
Rabbi yehuda omer, ilmale itgeniz mikkol
795: Vachol, la kaim alma afillu riga chada, ella itgeniz veizdera kehay zara deavid toladin uzerain veevin, uminneh itkayyaym alma. velet lach yoma, dela nafik minneh bealma, umekayem kolla deveh zan kudesha berich hu alma. uvechol atar delaan beorayyta belelya, chad chuta nafik mehahu or ganiz, veitmeshich al innun delaan bah, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi. veha okimna.

Yoma deitkam mashkena letatta, ma ketiv (Shemot 40:35) vela yachol moshe lavo el ohel moed ki shachan alav heanan. may heanan. chad chuta hava (nusach acher ammuda daanana) mehahu sitra deor kadmaa, denafak bechedva becholla (dechullah), alat lemashkena diltatta. umehahu yoma (kadmaa). la itgele, aval shimmusha ka meshammesh bealma, veihu mechaddesh bechol yoma ovada divreshit.

Rabbi yosi hava lae beorayyta, vahavu immeh rabbi yitzchak veribbi chizkiyya. amar ribbi yitzchak, ha chamenan deovada demashkena, kegavvna deovada deshamayim vaaretz, veha ittearu chavrayyay berazin dilhon zeiru, dela yachil bar nash lemechal befumeh, ulemeshat yedeh lego pumeh ulemivla.

Amar ribbi yosi, millin illen nesallek lon lego (nusach acher legabbeh) butzina kaddisha, deihu metakken tavshilin metikin, kema deatkin lon attika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin, veihu atkin tavshilin, delet behu atar, lemete achara, lemishde behu milcha. vetu, deyachil bar nash lemechal ulemishte uleashlema kerisoy mikkol idunin dealma uleishtaara, uveh yitkayyaym, (Melachim 2 4:44) veyitten lifnehem vayyochlu vayotiru kidvar Adonai.

Patach veamar, (Melachim 1 Adonai:26) vaAdonai, natan chachma lishlomo kaasher dibber lo vayhi shalom ben chiram uven shelomo vayichretu verit shenehem. hay kera ha ittemar bechamma duchete. aval vaAdonai, istakkemuta dilella vetatta kachada. vaAdonai ihu uve dineh. natan chachma, natan: keman deyahiv nevizbeza umattana lirchimeh. kaasher dibber lo, shelimu dechachmeta, beutera, uvishlam, uveshultanu, hada hu dichtiv kaasher dibber lo.

Vayhi shalom ben chiram uven shelomo, may tama. begin dahavo yade da leda, setimu demillin dahavo amre, uvene nasha acharanin la havo yade leistakkela uleminda behu kelal, uveginayyhu, ithaddar chiram leodaa lishlomo bechol milloy.

Shelomo malka, istakkal vahava chame, deha afillu behahu dara, dehava shelim mikkol darin acharanin, la hava reuta demalka illaa, deyitgele chachma kol kach al yedeh, (nusach acher velo itgalya) deitgele orayyta dehava setima bekadmita, ufatach lah pitchin. veaf al gav defatach, setimin innun, bar leinnun chakkimin dezachu, umitgamgeme behu, vela yade lemiftach behu puma. vedara da derabbi shimon sharya begavveh, reuta dekudesha berich hu begineh derabbi shimon, deyitgalyayn millin setimin al yedoy.

Aval tavavhna al chakkime dara, hech shavkin afillu riga chada, lemekam kame derabbi shimon lemile beorayyta, beod derabbi shimon kaim bealma, aval bedara da la yitneshe chachmeta mealma, vavy ledara kad yistalak ihu, vechakkimin yitmaatun, vechachmeta yitneshe mealma.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, vadday hachi ihu, deha yoma chad havena azil immeh bearcha, ufatach pumeh beorayyta, vachamena ammuda daanana naitz meella letatta, vechad zihara zahir go ammuda. dachilna dechilu saggi amina zakkaa ihu bar nash, dehachi izdaman leh behay alma.

Ma ketiv beh bemoshe, (Shemot 33:10) veraa kol haam et ammud heanan omed petach haohel vekam kol haam vehishtachavu ish petach oholo. yeot hu lemoshe, deihu nevia mehemana illaa al kol nevie alma, vedara hahu dekabbilu orayyta al tura desinay, vechamu kama nissin vechamma gevuran bemitzrayim veal yamma. aval hacha bedara da, zechuta illaa derabbi shimon ka avid, leitchazaa nissin al yedoy.
796: (Shemot 25) utechelet, amar rabbi yitzchak, techelet mehahu nuna deyamma deginosar, deihu beadveh dizvulun. veitzterich gavvna da leovada demashkena leitchazaa hay gon.

Patach veamar, (Bereshit 1:6) vayyomer elohim yehi rakia betoch hammayim viyhi mavdil ben mayim lamayim. hay rekia itbere bashsheni, deovada da missitra dismala ihu. uveyoma tinyayna deihu setar semala, itbere beh gehinnam, deihu nafik miggo hittucha denura dismala, uveyama itzteva bah gon tichla, deihu kuresyyay dedina.

Venatil hay yoma mayim dahavo missitra dimina, veinnun mayim dahavo missitra dimina, la itgallu ella beyom sheni. beyoma dileh, la itgele mayim, ella itchallaf, begin deitkelil da beda, veitbassam da beda. or deyoma kadmaa, nehiru kadmaa mikkol shita nehorin ihu. vehay or besitra deeshsha hava, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 10:17) vehaya or yisrael leesh. vehahu or deyisrael missitra dimina hava, itkelil beeshsha.

Veyoma kadmaa meinnun shita yomin, mayim ihu, vela shimmesh ovada demayim, ella ovada deor, deihu missitra deesh, deihu yom sheni. leachazaa dekudesha berich hu la bara alma, ella al shalom, uveorach shalom hava kolla. yoma kadmaa kol ma daavad, missitra dechavreh aved. yoma tinyayna besitra deyoma kadmaa avad hahu umana, veshimmesh bah, dechol chad shimmesh beovada dechavreh, leachazaa, deha itkelilu da beda. yoma telitaa, hava besitra detarvavyyhu, uveh hava argaman, veal da ketiv, ki tov ki tov tere zimne beyoma telitaa.

Techelet, da yoma tinyayna, itzteva bev gavvnin sumak veucham. utechelet, sumak ihu dileh, miyyoma tinyayna mammash, keen gon eshsha, veda ihu elohim, veyarit gon dedahava, decholla gavvna chada. techelta nafik miggo hahu gon sumak, vechad nachit letatta, itrechak gon sumak, veal go hahu atar deihu yamma, veitzteva gon tichla. hahu sumaka ayel go yamma, veitchallash gon dileh, veithaddar tichla, veda ihu elohim, aval lav ihu takkifa kekadmaa.

Ucham, gon da nafik mehittucha desumaka, kad ithattach veitchallash letatta behittucha dezuhama, venachit letatta, venafik mehahu zuhama gon sumak, mizzohama takkifa, umiggo zuhama takkifa, ithaddar leucham. vecholla mehahu sumaka kadmaa (sefer acher illaa) ithattach. vechol da itbere bashsheni, vehay ikre elohim acherim.

Hay ucham ihu chashuch yattir, dela itchaze gon dileh miggo chashocha. butzina kaddisha hachi amar, dehay gon ucham chashuch, bean atar itzteva. ella kad hahu sumaka ithattach bego tichla, veitarvu gavvnin, ithattach hittucha dezuhama lego tehome, veitavid mittamman refesh vatit. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 57:20) vayyigreshu memav refesh vatit. umiggo hahu tina dithome, nafak hahu chashuch deihu ucham, vela ucham ella chashuch yattir, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:2) vechoshech al peni tehom. amay ikre choshech, begin degavevn dileh chashuch, veachshich anpe biryayn. veda ihu sumak veucham, uvegin da la ketiv bashsheni ki tov.

Vei tema, veha ketiv (Bereshit 1:31) vehinni tov meod da malach hammavet, vehacha amart dela ittemar beginih ki tov. ella raza derazin hacha, deha vadday malach hammavet ihu tov meod. may tama. begin deha kol bene alma yade dimutun veyithadrun leafra, vesaggiin innun dimhaddere betiyyuveta lemarehon, begin dechilu da, vedachale lemechote kammeh. saggiin dachale min malka, miggo detalya retzua lekamayyhu. kama tava hahi retzua legabbe bar nash, deavdat lon tavin vekashitin, umetakkenin bearchayyhu kadka yeot. veal da vehinne tov meod. meod vadday.
797: Raza derazin, deolifna miggo butzina kaddisha vehinne tov, da malach chayyim. meod, da malach hammavt, deihu yattir. amay malach hammavet ihu tov meod. ella kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, kolla hava mittakkan ad la yete adam, deihu malka dehay alma. kevan deitbere adam, avad leh mittakkan beorach keshot, hada hu dichtiv, (Kohelet 7:29) asher asa haelohim et haadam yashar vehema vikshu chishshevonot rabbim, avad leh yashar, ulevatar sarach, veitrid migginta deeden.

Gan eden ihu beara, natia beinnun netian denata leh kudesha berich hu, kema deat amer (Bereshit 2:8) vayyitta Adonai elohim gan beeden mikkedem, ihu nata leh bishma shelim, kegavvna illaa leella. vechol diukenin illain kullehu, merukkeman umittzayyran behay gan eden diltatta, vetamman innun keruvim. lav innun gelifin biglifoy divne nasha middahava o mimmilla achara, ella kullehu nehorin dilella, gelifin umittzayyeyrin betziyyura merukkema, ovade yede umana dishma shelim dekudesha berich hu, vechullehu mechukkekan tamman. vechol diukenin vetziyyurin dehay alma, kullehu mittzayyeyran tamman, uggelifan umitchakkan tamman, kullehu kegavvna dehay alma.

Vaatar da ihu madora leruchin kaddishin, ben innun deatu lehay alma, ben innun dela atu lehay alma, veinnun dizminin lemete lehay alma. kullehu ruchin mitlabbeshan bilvushin vegufin ufartzufin kegavvna dehay alma, umistakkelan tamman beziv yekara demarehon, ad deatyayn lehay alma.

Beshaata denafke mittamman, lemete lehay alma, mitpashshetin innun ruchin, mehahu gufa ulevusha detamman, umitlabbeshin begufa uvilvusha dehay alma, veavdin diyyurehon behay alma, bilvusha vegufa da, deihu mittippa serucha.

Vechad mate zimneh lemehach ulenafka mehay alma, la nafik ad dehay malach hammavet afshit leh levusha degufa da. kevan deitpashshat hay gufa mehahu rucha, al yede dehahu malach hammavet, azla umitllabbesha behahu gufa achara divginta deeden, deitpeshit kad ate lehay alma. velet chidu lerucha, bar behahu gufa detamman, vechadde al deitpashshat mehay gufa dehay alma, veitlabbash bilvusha achara shelim, kegavvna dehay (nusach acher dehahu) alma, uveh yativ veazil veistakkal leminda berazin illain, ma dela yachil leminda uleistakkela behay alma begufa da.

Vechad itlabbeshat nishmeta behahu levusha dehahu alma, kama idunin, kama kisufin dilah tamman. ma garim legufa da, leitlabbesha beh rucha. have ema hahu deafshit leh levushin illen. vekudesha berich hu avid tivu im biryayn, dela afshit leh levar nash levushin illen, ad deatkin leh levushin acharanin yakkirin vetavin meillen.

Bar leinnun chayyayve alma, dela ahadru betiyyuveta shelemata lemarehon, deartilain atu lehay alma, veartilain yetuvun tamman. venishmeta azla bechissufa legabbe acharanin, delet lah levushin kelal, veittedanat behahu gehinnam divara, miggo hahu eshsha dilella. veit minnehon dimtzaftzefe vesalke, veillen innun chayyayve alma, dechashvi belibbayyhu teshuva, umitu, vela yachilu lemebad lah. illen itdanu tamman begehinnam, ulevatar metzaftzefe vesallekin.

Chame kama rachamanuta dekudesha berich hu im biryohi, deafillu deihu chayyayva yattir, vehirher teshuva, vela (Vayikra 220 amud bet) yachil lemebad teshuva, umit, hay bevadday, mekabbel onsha, ad deazil bela teshuva. levatar hahu reuta deshavve lemebad teshuva, la adiat mikkamme malka illaa, vekudesha berich hu atkin lehahu chayyayva ducheta, bemadora dishol, vetamman metzaftzefa teshuva. deha hahu reuta nachit mikkamme kudesha berich hu, vetavar kol gezzizin (sefer acher levatar dekabbil onsheh hahu reuta tava deshavve hahu chayyayva lemebad teshuva salleka kamme malka ilaa velo aadayat mittamman ad dekudesha berich hu atkin lehahu chayyayva ducheta bimdurat shaul ucheden hahu rayavetaa nachta mikkamme kudesha berich hu vatebaret kol gezzizin) detare madore gehinnam, umate lehahu atar dehahu chayyayva tamman, uvatash beh, veittear leh hahu reuta kemillekaddemin. ucheden metzaftzefa
798: Hahi nishmeta, lesalleka miggo madora dishol.

Velet reuta tava deyitavid mikkamme malka kaddisha. uvegin kach, zakkaa ihu man dimharher hirhurin tavin legabbe mareh, deaf al gav dela yachil lemebad lon, kudesha berich hu salik leh reuteh keillu avid. da letav. aval reuteh levish, la. bar hirhura dekochavim umazzalot, veha ukemuha chavrayyay.

Innun dela hirharu teshuva, nachte lishol, vela salke mittamman ledare darin. alayyhu ketiv, (Iyov 7:9) kalla anan vayyelach ken yored sheol lo yaale. al kadmae ketiv (Shmuel 1 2:6) Adonai memit umechayye morid sheol vayyaal.

Amar rabbi yehuda, dina deonshe degehinnam, ha olifna, deihu lemedan tamman lechayyayvayya, al ma itdanu benura degehinnam. ella gehinnam ihu nur dalik yemame velele, kegavvna dechayyayvayya mitchamman benura deyetzer hara, lemebar al pitgame orayyta. bechol chimuma vechimuma deinnun mitchammeman beyetzer hara, hachi ittokad nura degehinnam.

Zimna chada la ishtechach yetzer hara bealma, deailu leh go gushepanka defarzela, benukeba dithoma rabba. vechol hahu zimna, kava nura degehinnam, vela ittokad kelal. ahdar yetzer hara leatreh, sharu chayyayve alma leitchamma beh, shaari nura degehinnam leittokda, deha gehinnam la ittokad ella bechamimu detukepa deyetzer hara dechayyayvayya. uvehahu chamimu, nura degehinnam ittokad yemame velele, vela shachich.

Shiva pitchin innun laggehinnam, veshiva madorin innun tamman. shiva zine chayyayvin innun: ra. beliyyaal. chote. rasha. mashchit. letz. yahir. vechullehu lokovlayyhu it madorin laggehinnam, kol chad vechad kadka chazi leh. uchefum hahu darga dechata beh hahu chayyayva, hachi yahavin leh madora begehinnam.
Uvechol madora umadora, it malach memana al hahu atar, techot yeda deduma. vechamma elef veribbo immeh, dedayynin lon lechayyayvayya, kol chad vechad kema deitchaze leh behahu madora deihu tamman.

(Sefer acher eshsha degehinnam dilella, mate lehay gehinnam diltatta) eshsha degehinnam letatta, mate miggo eshsha degehinnam dilella, umate lehay gehinnam diltatta, veittokad, behahu ittearu dechamimu dechayyayvayya, deka mechamme garmayyhu go yetzer hara, vechol innun madorin delikin tamman.

Atar it begehinnam, vedargin tamman deikrun (252 amud alef, 265 2, pinchas 258 amud alef) tzoa rotachat, vetamman ihu zuhama denishmatin, innun demitlachlechan mikkol zuhama dehay alma. umitllabbenan vesallekin, veishtearat hahu zuhama tamman, veinnun dargin bishin deitkerun tzoa rotachat, itmanan al hahu zuhama. venora degehinnam shalta, behahu zuhama deishtearat.

Veit chayyayvin, innun demitlachlechan bechovayyhu tadir, vela itlabbenan minnayyhu, umitu belo teshuva, vechatu vehechotiu acharanin, vahavu keshe kedal tadir, vela itbaru kame marihon behay alma. illen (vayyeshev 190 amud bet) itdanu tamman behahu zuhama, uvehahi tzoa rotachat, dela nafkin mittamman lealmin. innun dimchabbelin archayyhu al ara, vela chashshu likara demarehon behay alma, kol innun itdanu tamman ledare darin, vela nafke mittamman.

Beshabbate uveyarche uvizmanne uvechagge, behahu atar nura ishtechach, vela itdanu, aval la nafke mittamman, kishar chayyayvin deit lehu nayycha. kol innun dimchallele shabbatot uzemane, vela chayyshe likara demarehon kelal, begin lemetar lon, ella mechallele befarhesya, kema deinnun la natre shabbate uzemani behay alma, hachi name la natrin leh behahu alma, velet lon nayycha.

Amar ribbi yosi, la tema hachi, ella natre shabbate uzemani tamman begehinnam beal karchayyhu. amar rabbi yehuda, illen innun ovde kochavim umazzalot, dela itpekadu, dela natre shabbat behay alma, natre leh tamman baal karchayyhu.
Bechol maale shabbeta kad yoma itkaddash, charozin
799: Azlin bechol innun madorin degehinnam: seliku dina dechayyayvayya, deha malka kaddisha atya, veyoma itkaddash, veihu aggin al kolla. umiyyad dinin istalaku, vechayyayvayya it lon nayycha. (vechol inun mechallele shabbatot uzemani befarhesya dinin sallekin minnayyhu 0) aval nura degehinnam la ishtekach, mealayyhu dela natre shabbat lealmin. vechol chayyayve gehinnam shaale alayyhu, may shena illen delet lon nayycha, mikkol chayyayvin dehacha. innun marehon dedina tayyvin lon, illen innun chayyayvin dekafru beh bekudesha berich hu, veavru al orayyta kulla, begin dela natru shabbat tamman, begin kach let lehu nayychin lealmin.

Veinnun chayyayvin kullehon, nafkin midduchetayyhu, veityeyhiv lon reshu lemehach lemecheme behu. umalach chad di shemeh santiriel, azil veappik lehahu gufa dilhon, veayil leh laggehinnam, leenehon dechayyayvayya, vechamman leh desalleka tolain, venishmeta let lah nayycha benura degehinnam.

Vechol innun chayyayvayya detamman, sacharin lehahu gufa, umachrize aleh, da ihu pelanya chayyayva, dela chayish likara demareh, kafar beh bekudesha berich hu, vechafar bechol orayyta kulla, vavy leh, tav dela yitbere, vela yete ledina da, ulekissufa da, hada hu (212 amud alef) dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:24) veyyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi ki tolatam lo tamut veishsham lo tichbe vehayu deraon lechol basar. ki tolatam lo tamut, min gufa. veishsham lo tichbe, min nishmeta. vehayu deraon lechol basar, vehayu day raon, ad dechol chayayvin degehinnam detamman, yiyimrun, day reiya da.
Ribbi yosi amar, vadday hachi hu, begin deshabbat ihu lokovel orayyta kulla, veorayyta ihi esh, begin deavru al esh deorayyta, ha esh degehinnam dalik, dela shachich mealayyhu lealmin.

Amar rabbi yehuda, levatar kad nafik shabbeta, ate hahu malach, umehader hahu gufa lekivreh, veittedanu tarvavyyhu, da lesitreh veda lesitreh. vechol da, beod degufa kayyayma al bureyeh, deha kevan degufa itakkol, let leh legufa kol illen dinin, vekudesha berich hu (Tehillim 78:38) lo yair kol chamato ketiv beh.

Kol chayyayvin dealma, beod degufa shelim bechol shayyfoy go kivra, itdanu gufa verucha, kol chad dina kadka chazi leh. kevan degufa itakkol, dina derucha ishtechach. man deitzterich lenafka, nafik. uman deitzterich lemeheve alayyhu nayycha, it lon nayycha. uman deitzterich lemeheve kitma veafra techot ragle detzaddikayyay. kol chad vechad, kadka chazi leh, itavid leh.

Veal da, kama tav lon, ben letztzadike, ben lechayyayve, lemehve gufa dilhon davik beara, uleitakkela go afra lizman kariv, vela lemeheve bekiyyuma kol hahu zimna saggi, begin leitdena gufa venafsha verucha tadir. deha let lach kol tzaddik vetzaddik bealma, delet leh dina dekivra. begin dehahu malach dimmana al kivre, kaim al gufa, vedan leh bechol yoma veyoma. im latzaddikim kach, lechayayvim al achat kamma vechamma.
Uvezimna degufa itakkol veitbele beafra, ha dina ishtechach mikkolla, bar meinnun chaside kayaymin dealma, deinnun itchazun lesalleka nishmathon lehahu atar illaa deitchaze lon, uzeirin innun bealma.

Kol innun metin dealma, kullehu metin al yede demalacha mechabbela, bar innun demetin beara kaddisha, (vechulehu metin al yede demalacha mechabbela deihu malach hammavet, vechol inun metin di beara kaddisha) la metin al yedoy, ella al yede demalacha derachame deshallit beara.

Amar rabbi yitzchak, i hachi, may shevacha ihu lemoshe uleaharon umiryam, dichtiv behu (Bamidbar 33 Devarim la) al pi Adonai, deillen la mitu al yede dehahu malach mechabbela, veat amart, dechule alma innun demitu beara deyisrael, la metin al yedoy deda.
